edpd, rl ici fd, ikel lae` lagipz "`dad xad" adzblez lae, kckzia: "lirwa `yx tcd `z `axdm", kne ypza`x anwem `gx:
eiy cxj iyx ltpi `iy, yed lkl pty, ewxea dcax n`c n`c, lrexx eld`ix `ex d`dad dzwerd enqezxz alae, ldiez n`ixd azews `exd k`y aerxd adzblez lae enege, lnqex ptye ld' ebete en`ece akl la eakl pty en`c, nrenw` cla` a`nz l`nize, eatxh ayrz wxi`z ynr eaxkezid, kne yiza`x.
ede`, k`yx iyim `l lae nd y`nx dkzea: "knim dtpim ltpim, ko la d`cm `l d`cm"; tixey, kne ykcnez evexz dtpim yd`cm nx`d anim, ko px`d le ym anim `ezd vexd rvnd kkd nny, "la d`cm" dp`no a`daze l`iy `gx, dxi d`dad fe nrexxz `dad ala gaixe `lie bm ko, ldiez `edaim p`npim fd lfd, atxh kyxe`d `daz gaixe `lie.

edpd, kkl dcaxim d`ld ekkl dgfieo dfd, ebcel izx n`c aktli ktliim l`io wu, ryd lpe `ldipe. ki lbcelze `io gwx, e"`ide nnl` kl rlnio" e"qeaa kl rlnio", epecr nfdx dwcey ed`x"i fkxepe laxkd, xiaei ddiklez edrelnez rc `io nqtx, eakl relm edikl xiae` xaaez nl`kim l`io wu ezkliz, ekne ykzea abnx`: kzia, "diy nqtx lbcecie", ekzia, "`ls `ltio iynyepid, exiae xaao wcnedi ke'", enypi: "`ls `ltio eke' nqtx bcec `gc, `al lbcecie `io nqtx", ekelm wnid kl` nny gyiai, eahlim anvi`ez nny, kaihel caex `gc nny lbai ndez dpty dncaxz ervnezd, arec ydid ciaexd rciio angyazd `e axveo egncz dla, kpfkx lril a`xikez:
ekelm ye`lim: "`id nwem kaece", erepim: "nl` kl d`xu kaece" dm iyx`l rne, ki dpig dwcey axej de` `z drliepim e`z dzgzepim, el` agx akelm ki `m aiyx`l rne, edevi`m nnvxim, rxez d`xu, nwem dfedn` edhen`d, l` rl ici nl`j el` rl ici ke', `l` dwcey axej de` akaece earvne ixc lym, kne ykzea: "e`xc ldvile ebe'", kci lwxam `lie awixea eigec `nizi, adzwyxez dpty nny aagipz pyiwio td ltd lcax cax d' fe dlkd, e`zcawez xeg` axeg` di` dybz dzexd eicirz xvepe egknze, ckel` gc nny, ebm aagipz giaew de` wiem dnvez nryiez axn"g `axim, cxn"g tiwecio do xn"g `axio cnlk` kpfkx lril, ecxj kll, pglwio lyly agipez: inio eyn`l e`nvr, ydo: gqc cio xgnim zxio cxerio ebet` eke'.
efde y`enxim: "`yx wcype anvezie", k`cm dnwcy `yd ldiez niegcz rne aigec bnex, kne ykzea: "ecaw a`yze edie layx `gc". kkd nny eizx rl ko l`io wu, de` igec pty d`ldiz dreqwz azexd envez epty dgiepiz elaeyido dpfkxim lril a`ex `io qes axej de`.
elko dnyil ylnd rlie dylem a"yix dyixim", igec fd ligec gzo ekld, acaiwd gyiwd egtivd agiaew epiyew.

ki rl ici igec dpty edzkllezd a`ex `io qes axej de`, dxi di` anrlz encxbz wceyz `io qes axej de` nny, n`gx ynziigcz enzkllz ae izaxj, edie l`gcim nny. efde ykzea: "ediizm li wceyim ki wcey `pi d', e`acil `zkm no drnim ldiez li", e`enx: "eryizm `z kl nvezi ediizm wceyim l`ldikm `pi d' `ldikm ebe'"; tixey, ki rl ici wiem dnvez dxipi `led ylkm, kne "`ldi `axdm `ldi ivgw eke'", ypwx` ko ntpi yd`aez die agipz nxkad le izaxj eahlim epkllim a`exe.
ekkd de` akl pty niyx`l ayrz rqw dzexd ednvez. elko giiae xaezipe fkxepm laxkd lwem elrnec ntpi kl reqw anved, `s `m de` aex erm d`xu, ediipe, ntpi d' dyeko enzlay aptye ayrd fe, xw y`io ptye nxbyz, ntpi nqj dgenx dbetpi, yl` pfckj, engyij ripi dpty nx`ez nx`ez `ldim kne d`aez ekiev` ado, yx`e relnm agiidm.
efde y`nx `qs axeg dwcy arc kl kpqz iyx`l yabeld: "e`pi arx el` `cr, adnez diizi rnj, e`pi znic rnj". klenx y`s rl ti y`pi kadnd adiezi rnj, el` `cr el` `xbiy aptyi igec fd yztel rlid `inzd etgc zgld, e`gx kj `dad xad azrpebim `e kxyti `y, kncz dvciwim ypfckj genxm; ekpecr, ycrz de` lyeo dxbyd apty, ede` kell gqc ebaexd `s rl ti ko, "`pi znic rnj", ki `io dgenx nepr igec dpty a`ex `io qes axej de` dnnl` kl rlnio, ekne ykzea: "bm geyj l` igyij nnj".

ebm nyde gnu `e hlhel newvd tebm awceyd yrl ptye kne awceyz pty dvciw, ki zexd `gz lkelpe.

`al `pgpe, ixeyd enzpd di` lpe, ypzo lpe `z zexze, edlaiy ad xvepe egknze izaxj, dniegcim andeze ervneze izaxj azkliz digec, edxi fd k`le pzo lpe `z rvne kaikel. kne ykzea afdx dwcey rl tqew: "eiwge li zxend" c"li" klenx "`ezi", eded lid lninx "ezxend", `l` nyem ckel` gc, riio ym diha :
efde y`enxim: "ezzo lpe d' `ldipe a`dad ke'", "ki a`ex tpij pzz lpe d' `ldipe ke'". elfd `io nepr lpe ncaiwez dpty aigece e`exe izaxj, `l` dxveo, y`m `io d`cm xevd kll gq eylem lcawd ae ke'. `al nic yxevd enwal ennyij rlie `ldeze izaxj e`enx "d' `ldipe d' `gc" dxi nnil` pkllz ptye aigece izaxj, c"xeg `iizi xeg e`nyij xeg", edi` agipz ivi`z nvxim. elko zwpe txyz ivi`z nvxim ayrz wxi`z ynr cew`, `s ydi` nved atpi rvnd, el` nnvez wxi`z ynr, kc`iz` abnx` eteqwim, `l` ntpi ydo cax `gc nny. eko aqes txyz ivi`z nvxim nqiim bm ko "`pi d' `ldikm", ediipe bm ko kne ypza`x lril:

e`tile relm da` ebo rco drlieo, ncex pynez dvciwim dbcelim edpynez rvno, e`io vxij lenx dnl`kim do aagipz bael ezkliz, ki iy bael ldybzo a`ex `io qes axej de` dn`ix rlido adzlayez gknd aipd crz ke'. elko iy bael ldp`zo ypdpio nfie dykipd enzrpbio a`ex d', ki `io ikelio lwal dp`d ezrpeb aagipz `io qes nny, yl` izahle nnvi`ezo eigfxe lnwexo.
edpd, txhiez dvnvenim, `ij end `io k`o nwem ai`exm. `j cxj kll, do dm agipz dqzx edrlm dnykz d`ex edgiez, yl` i`ix eienyj lzgzepim aagipz bilei, ldzlay eldytir ado eldgiezm ldiez iy n`io ki `m, nrh nfrx `ex egiez, akci yidie aagipz bael ezkliz, ydi` d`xd nerhz n`c enny kl` gyiai lbai agipz d`xd ali bael ezkliz, e`io aipidm rxj eigq kll, kpecr tixey nlz rxj' anqtxim, y`gc anqtx, iy le rxj lbai nqtx `ls `ltim, yde` glw `gc npi `ls `ltim, `al lbai cax yde` aagipz ali bael enqtx kll `io kpbce yem rxj anqtxim, y`tile `ls `lti `ltim exiae` xaaez, `ipo `tile krxj nqtx `gc lbai `ls `lti `ltim exae` xaaez, `l` kl` nny gyiai.
ekkd nny di` agipz dd`xd nerhz fe, dnzlayz arelnez rliepim ezgzepim ldytir adm ldgiezm, lbai rxj `ex dbpef eprlm, yde` aagipz "`io qes", e`ipe nzlay enytir arelnez aagipz bilei ldgiezm, `l` nwis rlidm nlnrld, epwx` "qeaa kl rlnio".
e`io dtixey qeaa enwis nlnrld aagipz nwem gq eylem, ki l` yiij kll agipz nwem axegpiez. `l` xevd lenx, qeaa enwis nlnrld lrpio agipz bilei dytrd, ki ddytrd yde` aagipz bilei arelnez pwx`z aym "dlayd", ynzlayz arelnez, ki dm nlaiyim enyibim ddytrd ynwalim, nd y`io ko ddytrd y`ipd aagipz bilei `l` adqzx edrlm, e`io drelnez nyibim `ezd `ipd pwx`z "nzlayz" `l` nwtz eqeaaz. dlkj, n`gx ydrelnez dm aagipz bael ezkliz pnv` y`io dytrz `ex `io qes nzlay enzbld adm aagipz bilei, xw nrh nfrx, d`xd nerhz nvenvnz n`c n`c, edi` xw kci ldgiezm aagipz bael ezkliz.
`al riwx d`ex ali vnvem kl kj pwx` "nwis" e"qeaa", n`gx y`io dytrze nzbliz azekm, n`gx ydm aagipz bael ezkliz.
ednyl afd, dpd d`xu dlfe dbyniez, `s y"nl` kl d`xu kaece", ediipe `ex `io qes axej de`, kne ykzea: "dl` `z dynim e`z d`xu `pi nl`, p`m d'". `s rl ti ko, `io nzlay azekd aagipz bilei ddytrd, xw giez nrh nfrx, agipez cenm eveng lac. ekl `ex `io qes axej de` pwx` qeaa rlid, `s yde` azekd nny. n`gx y`io dytrze nzbliz ad iezx, xw nytir ad aagipz dqzx edrlm, ekl dytrd yaagipz dqzx, pwx` nwis nlnrld, ki, "rln` c`zkqi`" de` lnrld ancxbd n"rln` c`zbli`".
elwxa `l dykl iezx, de` acxj nyl: kne d`cm ynviix acrze `ifd cax yx`d `e yxe`d, dpd `s ykl bes rvm dcax dde` ebae ezeke ezej zeke, kele nveiix acrze engyaze, ntpi yx`de kele `e yxe`de, dpd pwx`z crze nwtz dcax dde` kele. edcax dde` news acrze engyaze, xw, y`ipe news aterl nny xw acnieo ngyaz d`cm ecrze.
`al dwcey axej de` ckzia aid: "ki l` ngyaezi ngyaezikm ke'", dxi ngyaze ecrze yiecr kl dpax`im, nwtz kl pax` epax` nx`ye erc zgzize, ezeke ezej zeke, dkl aterl nny.
lnyl, kcex d`xu dlfe, dxi icirze izaxj nwtz kl reai kcex d`xu ekl `yx azeke ezej zeke rc zgzize, dkl aterl nny, ydxi, icird fe, di` giez kl reai kcex d`xu kele, edzdeeze n`io liy. xw yl` did nzded knez yde` rzd, arl bael ezkliz egiez nerhz n`c, kci agipez cenm eveng. `m l`, rl ici vnvenim xaim ervenim, yvnvne d`ex edgiez ypzlay akcex d`xu ldgieze elwiine aagipz bael ezkliz, eaagipez cenm eveng alac.
`j icirze izaxj dniegcz andeze ervneze ki "de` dncr ede` diecr ede` dicer, eaicirz rvne kaikel iecr kl dpax`im, el` aicird ygeu nnpe kicirz d`cm, ki kelm pnv`im n`nizze izaxj, ecax fd `io aikelz d`cm ldyibe rl aexie eke'"
dbdd kne ykza dxna"m fkxepe laxkd, edqkine ne gkni dwald, kne ykzea atxc"q ndxn"w fkxepe laxkd. eko de` lti walz d`x"i fkxepe laxkd, aqec dvnvenim edzlayez `exez aklim, kne ypza`x l il txw a':
dxi icird fe, n`gx ydi` aagipz `io qes, `ipd pwx`z aym nzlayz akcex d`xu yde` arl bael ezkliz, `l` nwtz eqeaaz. `s yicird fe kellz kl raie ezeke aterl nny, endeed `eze rl ici fd n`io liy, ekne ypza`x anwem `gx:
edpd, `s ki txhi agipez ddqzx eddrlm `ex `io qes axej de`, adyzlylez drelnez rc ypax` relm dfd dbyni rvne nqtx, enipim nnipim yepim, kicer lhernim nru dgiim, `j cxj kll, dm ylyd nipi vnvenim rvenim klliim. lylyd nipi relnez klliim. eakl kll iy xae` xaaez txhiim, edm ylyd relnez axi`d, ivixd, ryid. ki relm d`vilez de` `ldez nny.
ekci laxe` relm daxi`d, ydo pynez enl`kim rliepim, `yx raeczm ld' aagipz gknd aipd crz dnzlayim adm, edm nyibim enwalim ndm did zgld vnvem rvem, kpfkx lril.
eko naxi`d livixd, ki `ex nrh nfrx dnzlay arelm daxi`d, rciio de` aagipz `io qes lbai relm divixd, e`i `tyx ldzlay ae, `l` rl ici vnvem edrlm. eko nivixd lryid ekne ypza`x anwem `gx ai`ex ylyd vnvenim `le a`xikez, lwxa `l yklipe dcl .
ezkliz kl dvnvenim de` kci laxe` bes d`cm dgenxi, el`ktii` lqhx` `gx`, eldiez izxeo d`ex no dgeyj adrlez d`cm `z ptye d`ldiz edgiepiz elaeyid ekl kgez dbes kelo ld' lace, kpfkx lril a`xikez, ki fd zkliz dyzlylez drelnez.
edpd, "knim dtpim ltpim" kne ydwcey axej de`, kaikel, dpig eqilw lvc `gc, cxj nyl, `z `exe dbcel dalzi zkliz, ebpfe edqzixe ab' nipi vnvenim yepim, edkl ayail `daz d`cm dzgzeo ldrleze ld', ki "`dad cegwz dayx", rl `gz knd eknd, aktli ktliim l`io wu, ki x`ei l`cm bm ko ldpig elrfea kl `yx le npty erc ayx, eldtwix dkl ayail lcawd ae izaxj acaiwd gyiwd egtivd, el` idid yem nepr naiz enageu, l` bes el` pty el` nneo, el` `yd eapim.
eafd ieao hea hrm ecrz lzwpz gknim, yzwpe axkez wxi`z ynr "yzim ltpid ke'", clk`exd, `io ldm yiikez kll rm wxi`z ynr, kne ykzae dxya"` ey`x teqwim, elnd wx`e `ezo "axkez wxi`z ynr"? elnd zwpe `ezo ltpid ceew`?
`l` nyem yriwx wxi`z ynr lwiim "akl laaj ke'" "aypi ivxij ke'", cdiipe, lrnec pbc kl nepr n`daz d'; e"laaj" do d`yd eilcid, ylaae yl `cm wyexd ado ahare, kne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd rl tqew: "de` `nx eidi" "fe `yd", "de` ved eirnec" "`le apim"; e"ptyj" e"n`cj" knynre, gii enfepi ldtwix dkl ayail `daz d'.
e`ij ia` d`cm dgenxi lncd fe? lkj, qicxe zgld axkz "ievx `ex", eym p`nx epypd a`xikez rpio eqcx dnl`kim "drencim axem relm", ldecir bcelze yl dwcey axej de`, `ij ykelm ahlim l`exe izaxj, "enynirim aix`d ke', enwciyim ke', e`enxim aix`d wcey ke'", klenx, yde` neacl ndo e`ipe nzlay ado aagipz bilei, `l`, "nl` kl d`xu kaece" di` kpqz iyx`l lnrld eiyx`l lnhd, kpfkx lril.
eko "d`etpim egiez dwecy axry bcel eke', axej kaec d' nnwene", lti y`io iecrim enyibim nwene, ekne y`enxim: "ki de` lace nxem ewcey".
e`gx kj axkd ypid: "`daz relm `dazpe d' `ldipe", klenx, ydpig kl va` nrld dwceyim, edyxd ykipze rlipe, ldiez pwx` "`ldipe", kne "`ldi `axdm ke'" kpfkx lril. ediipe, ki `dad cegwz dayx, elko pwx` "`daz relm" ydi` agipz vnvem `exe dbcel dalzi zkliz, ldzlay aagipz bael dpwx` "relm", araex `daz rne iyx`l, kci lwxam `lie, likll aigece e`gceze izaxj.
efde y`enxim "gnld bceld eizixd", tixey, izixd rl wxaz `ldim yakl va` nrld; "eape agxz nkl rm elyeo" de` dbes dgenxi dpcnd agenxieze lbeti `enez drelm; "ewxazpe eke' ldecez eke'", etixey dec`d iza`x anwem `gx; "eligcj ke'" likll aigece izaxj, kpfkx lril.
edpd, k`yx iyim dnykil `ld dcaxim `l renw` cla` eneg`, `fi nnil`, "knim dtpim ltpim" zzldh ptye ezzlay axeg pciad, ldzpca ldpig elrfea kl `yx le npbc, exw lcawd ae izaxj elikll a`exe acaiwd gyiwd eke', aagipz pyiwio e"`zcawez xeg` axeg`" kpfkx lril.
`j `ij di` agipz "`zcawez xeg` axeg`"? lfd `nx: "edie dcaxim d`ld ke' rl laaj, ecaxz am ke'", ekne ykzea aru giim, yigec dpyiwio, riwxe de` igec gknd aipd crz agknd aipd crz, ede` rieo dzexd; edtd de` nev` dxeg ebileie aagipz bilei, ediipe agipz dcaex acaxi zexd, "ki rl nev` ti d' igid d`cm".
enkl nwem, l` iv` ici geaze adxdex erieo lace rc yievi` aytzie, kci ldnyij `ex `io qes axej de` lnhd rc pty dgiepiz dyekpz acm d`cm, dnzded ncenm veng gi, kci ldrlez kelo ld' rm kl drelm kele, elkllo aigece e`exe izaxj, `yx i`ix l`xu elcxim aagipz bilei, "epbld kaec d', ex`e kl ayx eke'", yfde zkliz dyzlylez kl drelnez, ldiez kaec d' nl` kl d`xu dlfe cew` aagipz bilei, l`dtk` gyek` lpdex` enxix` lnizw`, kpfkx lril a`xikez.

edpd, rl `dad fe, dypiz, yiij lyeo nved eveei, cdiipe, lyem lae ecrze acaxim dnrexxim `z d`dad. `al a`dad x`yepd, ydi` yldaz dreld n`lid, l` yiij lyeo veei enved kll. el` rec, `l` ydi` nzo ykxo yl vciwim, lhrem nrio relm da` arelm dfd, yrlid p`nx: "raecz nzpd `zo `z kdepzkm", kne yiza`x anwend.
`j dpd icer liecrim, hrn` cwx` n`i ckzia: "ki yar itel vciw ewm", eatxh yd`cm pwx` "ndlj" el` "renc", evxij lilj nncxbd lncxbd, el` lrnec ancxbd `gz lrelm, eaio ncxbd lncxbd, hxm yibir lncxbd rliepd nnpd, de` aagipz "ptild" nncxbd dx`yepd. `j, "ki itel l` iehl" kzia, e`ipd pwx`z ptild, `l` lbai ncxibze dx`yepd, el` lbai y`x kl `cm gq eylem, y`s rl ti ko, de` lnrld nkl d`cm araecze, ki py`x ad agipz xyine nncxibze dx`yepd. `j riwxd, n`dad ypzgpj edexbl ad nprexie, ahxm ydbir lncxbz vciw. efde ykzea: "bm ki ifwio ebe'". edpd, x`yiz dcaxim dnrexxim d`dad edix`d eiqeco di` d`nepd dhdexd ep`npd aigece e`gceze izaxj eizrld:
ldaio nrh nfrx nd ykzea afdx, c"ynr iyx`l ke'" de` "igec` ril`d", e"axej ym kaec nlkeze lrelm erc" de` "igec` zz`d":
eicrz diem edyaez `l laaj, ki d' de` d`ldim aynim nnrl erl d`xu nzgz `io rec. evxij ldaio: eki zrld rl crzj yiy `ldim pyxd anim nzgz l`xu, yvxij ldfdix kl kj "edyaez `l laaj"?
dpd, kzia: "lrelm, d', caxj pva aynim", etixy darl ym hea fkxepe laxkd: ki "caxj" y`nxz "idi xwir azej dnim ebe'" ziaez e`eziez `le, do pvaez erencez lrelm azej xwir dynim, enleayez azej kl dxwirim lrelm ldgiezm, kckzia: "ecax `ldipe iwem lrelm", "ecaxie giim ewiinim lrc ke'", ki `ile die d`eziez nqzlwez kxbr gq eylem egefxez lnwexo, die kl dynim `io e`tq nny, edie kl` die kll, ekne wecm n`nx "idi xwir ke'" nny.
eko akl daxe`im yakl drelnez rliepim ezgzepim, e`tile `xu dlfe dbyniz eagipz cenm nny, `ile die nqzlwez nnpd kxbr gq eylem d`eziez nryxd n`nxez yado pax`z d`xu ayyz ini ax`yiz, dizd gefxz l`io e`tq nny, kne ltpi yyz ini ax`yiz nny.
efde y`nx d`x"i fkxepe laxkd, ybm acenm nny, kne `apim ertx enim, iy agipz pty egiez xegpiz. cdiipe, agipz dzlayez `eziez dcaex nryxd n`nxez dngiez endeez `z dcenm, ldiez iy n`io e`tq yltpi yyz ini ax`yiz.
e`s yl` defkx ym "`ao" aryxd n`nxez yazexd, `s rl ti ko, pnyj giez l`ao rl ici vixetim egileti `eziez, dnzblblez axl"` yrxim tpim e`gex, kne ykzea aqtx ivixd, rc ynyzlyl nryxd n`nxez epnyj ndo vixes ym "`ao", ede` gieze yl d`ao.
eko akl dpax`im yarelm, dynez ypwx`im adm alyeo dwcy do do `eziez dcaex, dnyzlylez nncxbd lncxbd nryxd n`nxez yazexd, rl ici giletim eznexez d`eziez axl"` yrxim, rc ynbirez enzlayez a`eze pax` ldgieze.
lti y`io txhi dpax`im ikelim lwal giezm nryxd n`nxez rvno yazexd, ydgiez dpnyj ndo rvno bcel n`c nagipz dpax`im txhiim, e`io kg adm lwal dgiez, `l` rl ici yiexc dgiez enyzlyl nncxbd lncxbd tgezd nnpd, rl ici giletim eznexez d`eziez, ebinhxi`ez ydo gyaeo d`eziez, rc yiekl ldzvnvm eldzlay eldzdeez nnpe pax` txhi.
efd yne `yx iwx`e le alyeo dwcy, de` kli lgiez dnvenvm a`eziez ym fd, ypyzlyl nryxd n`nxez yazexd, yiy adm kg egiez laxe` iy n`io, eldgieze lrelm, c"`exiiz` ewecy` axij de` kel` gc":
edpd, nk`o zyeaz dnipim ebilei yexy hrezm, dketxim adybgd txhiz ea`ezez enetzi dzexd, yherim acniepm dkefa, yncnio nryd d' "reyd ynim e`xu" lnryd `pey ezgaelezie, ki k`yx iv` lvexs kli yea `io dkli vxij lici dvexs, ki `s yicie nqelwez dinpe edelj le ayew dkli wiim azapize evlne nny k`yx iv` nici dvexs, kj ncnio dqklim d`le nryd ynim e`xu.
`j "hg nx`ez ripidm", ddacl dbcel yaio nryd `pey ezgaelezie, yde` iy niy, xw ynypd dvexd edznepd nznepz gzikz kqs lznepz kli, lnryd ynim e`xu, yde` iy n`io.
ede` tl` bcel iezx nwxirz im qes rl cxj nyl, y"delij d' `z dim axeg wcim rfd kl dlild eiawre dnim", e"pvae kne pc" ekgend e`ile dtqiw d' `z dxeg kxbr die dnim gefxim epibxim anexc kcxkm eharm, el` wne kgend ali qtw, `s ydhar dfd anim bm ko pax` engecy iy n`io, ydxi genz `apim pvaz nrvnd ali xeg, xw yhar dnim `ipe ko.
ekl yko ewl egenx aaxi`z iy n`io, ydi` lnrld ndhar, edtl` etl` iezx nwxirz im qes, rl `gz knd eknd yadqzlwez kg daex` no dpax` gq eylem iyea dpax` l`io e`tq nny. `l` vxij ldiez kg dterl aptrl znic, ldgieze elwiine. edo do agipez `eziez dcaex nryxd n`nxez yadm pax`e.
erl fd p`nx: "e`zd ngid `z kelm" `l zwxi "ngid", `l` "nded", cdiipe, iy n`io, e"`zd" do agipez d`eziez n`l"s erc zi"e, edd"` di` d' nev`ez dtd, nwex d`eziez. edo do agipez `eziez dcaex nryxd n`nxez yadm pax`e.
e`s y`io le cnez dbes dxi nwx` nl` cax dkzea: "eicax d'", "ei`nx d'", edi` agipz dzblez dk"a `eziez rliepez lpai`im, enzlayez ayklm edybzm anx`d dpae`d, ebm angyazm eciaexm, kne ykzea: "xeg d' cax ai, enlze rl lyepi", ekne y`nx d`x"i fkxepe laxkd ayrx dpae`d .
ekrio fd di` dzlayez d`eziez aaxe`im, kckzia: "acax d' ynim prye, eaxeg tie kl va`m", xw, ydi` rl ici dyzlylez xaez ervenez, rc yiexcez lryid betpiz, nd y`io ko dybz dpai`im, di` a`vilez dnzlayz arelm daxi`d:
edpd, `gxi dcaxim ed`nz d`ld, kl nykil rl cax iaio l`yexe, `ij ykl pax` eiy de` a`nz pgya l`io e`tq nny lbai kg dterl exeg tie yaptrl, dnded `eze znic enevi`e n`io nny liy.
end ykl pax` eptrl px`d lpe liy ennyez, fde, ngnz y`io `pe nyibim exe`im aripi ayx `z kg d' exeg tie yapax`, `al `ile pizpd xyez lrio lx`ez eldyib `z dgiez exegpiez yakl pax`, dyetr ae n"nev` ti d'" exeg tie l` did byniez dpax` egenxe ennye px`d kll lripipe, ki de` ahl anvi`ez nny lbai dgiez edxegpiez yae, n`gx ynalrci dxegpiez, did `io e`tq nny, kne wecm yyz ini ax`yiz nny, edxegpiez dyetr rlie n"nev` ti d'" exeg tie, de` lace dnevi`e znic n`tq e`io liy, ended `eze, `m ko, `tq alrce a`nz.
ednyl lfd de`, `ex dyny "dn`ix l`xu elcxim", yde` fie e`ex dnztyh nbes dyny epx`d lrio kl, n`ix rl d`xu eagll drelm, edpd, fd tyeh, y`ex efie dfd iype bm ko abes egenx kcex dyny rvne yaynim, y`m nztyh en`ix lnxgew kl kj, kl yko yiekl ld`ix anwene nny, xw yym, anwene nny, pgya dfie dfd l`io e`tq nny, ki ahl nny anvi`ez lbai bes kcex dyny, yde` nwex d`ex edfie dfd, ydfie ed`ex dfd, `ipe xw d`xd n`ixd nbes ervm kcex dyny; xw agll drelm, zgz kl dynim erl d`xu, y`io k`o bes kcex dyny anvi`ez px`d k`o d`ex edfie dfd liy nny lrio kl, epetl rlie k`o ym "iy" a`nz, nd y`io ko kyde` anwexe abes dyny `io petl rlie ym "iy" kll, xw ym "`io" e"`tq", ki a`nz, de` ym l`io e`tq nny, y`io n`ix ym xw nwexe lace, yde` bes dyny dn`ix, e`tq alrce.
ekcaxim d`ld nny, acnezm kvlnm, dm kl daxe`im lbai ytr d`ldi nxeg tie, dyetr rlidm ended `ezm, ede` nwexm, edm rvnm, `ipm, xw kne `ex efie nztyh no dytr exeg d' dyetr enzlay azekm enevi`m n`io liy, elko dm ahlim anvi`ez lbai nwexm, kne `ex dyny yahl anvi`ez epgya l`io e`tq nny, e`ipe pwx` aym "iy" kll kyde` anwexe, xw zgz dynim y`io ym nwexe, kj kl daxe`im, `io petl rlidm ym "iy" kll, `l` lripi ayx ylpe, y`io `pe xe`im enyibim kll `z dnwex, yde` xeg d' dnded `ezm, elko px`d lripipe byniez dpax`im egenxm ennym ydm iy bnex, kne ypx`d `ex dyny iy bnex ky`ipe anwexe.
xw yafd, `io dnyl cend lpnyl lbnxi lk`exd, yanyl, `io dnwex anvi`ez kll agll drelm erl d`xu ypx`d ym `exe liy bnex, nd y`io ko kl daxe`im, dm anwexm znic, xw y`io dnwex px`d lripi ayx. elnd `ipo ahlim anvi`ez lnwexm? `j ldaio fd vxij ldwcim:
ki dpd kzia: "ki yny enbo d' `ldim", tixey, "nbo" de` pxzw lyny, ldbo yiekle daxiez lqale, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "lrzic la` dwcey axej de` nevi` gnd npxzwd, xyrim picepio ad ke'". ekne ydpxzw nbio arc dyny, kj ym "`ldim" nbio lym dei"d axej de`.
cym dei"d, tixeye ynded `z dkl n`io liy, edie"c nynyz rl dtreld ydi` alyeo ded eznic, kctixy xy"i rl tqew: "kkd iryd `iea kl dinim", ediipe dgiez dpytr akl xbr nny akl daxe`im nnev` ti d' exege, ended `ezm n`io liy akl xbr, ki l` ci ldm and ypax`e ayyz ini ax`yiz ldiez wiinim afd, kne ypza`x lril.
edpd, aqicex yagie yl dwcey axej de` kzia: "dbcel dbaex ke'", etixey "dbcel" di` ncz gqc edztyhez dgiez akl drelnez eaxe`im l`io wu ezkliz, ldiez axe`im n`io liy ewiinim agqc gpm, epwx`z "bceld", ki a`d nbcelze yl dwcey axej de` akaece earvne, "ki bcel d' elbcelze `io gwx", elko nytir bm ko giez edzdeez n`io liy lrelnez eaxe`im `io wu, yhar dhea ldhia.
edpd, kne yncd fe di` yage yl dwcey axej de` lace, y`io aikelz yem pax` laxe` iy n`io eldgieze, ebm, ncd fe di` lnrld ndyklz kl daxe`im edybzm, y`io kg aykl yem pax` ldykil eldyib ncd fe eiklzd laxe` iy n`io eldgieze, ki daxi`d iy n`io de` cax ylnrld nykl dpax`im, ki di` nncz bcelze yl dwcey axej de`, edwcey axej de` encezie `gcez tyeh, kc`iz` afdx dwcey c"`ide ebxnedi gc", ekym y`io aikelz yem ykl pax` ldyib aex`e, kj `ipe ikel ldyib ncezie.
ekne y`io aikelz yem ykl pax` ldyib ncz bcelze, ydi` dikelz laxe` iy n`io eldgieze, kckzia: "relm gqc iapd" kj nny `io aiklze ldyib ncz baexze yl dwcey axej de`, ydi` ncz dvnvem enpirz dztyhez dgiez nbcelze, nlixc eldzblez rl dpax`im ldgiezm elwiinm abilei, ki `m adqzx tpim, ydgiez nqzzx abes dpax`, ek`ile bes dpax` de` cax atpi rvne, e`ipe dztyhez dgiez edxegpiez kdztyhez dfie ed`ex ndyny, `l` de` cax atpi rvne.
e`s ya`nz, `ipe cax atpi rvne, `l` kne dztyhez d`ex ndyny, nkl nwem, do do baexezie yl dwcey axej de`, `yx kl ikel, lvnvm dgiez edxegpiez dpytr nxeg tie eldqzixe, yl` iahl bes dpax` anvi`ez.
efd, `io aykl yem pax` ldyib ndez dvnvem eddqzx, eyidid `s rl ti ko bes dpax` pax` n`io liy, kne y`io ikelz aykl yem pax`, ldyib ndez daxi`d n`io liy.
edpd, agipz dvnvem edqzx dgiez pwx` aym "klim", edgiez rvne pwx` aym "`ex", ykne ydkli nkqd rl nd yazeke, kj agipz dvnvem nkqd enqzix d`ex edgiez dyetr; edklim do do d`eziez, yyxyo d' `eziez npvt"j, ydo d' baexez dnglwez entxicez ddal edwel ad' nev`ez dtd ldzdeez k"a `eziez, eyxy dd' baexez de` "aevip` cwxcepiz`", ydi` baexd ril`d c"rziw ienio", eyxy dgqcim de` bm ko gqc c"rziw ienio", kicer liecri go :
edpd, rl fd `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "azgld rld angyad laxe` `z drelm ancz dcio, x`d y`io drelm nzwiim yzs ae ncz xgnim", cdiipe, dzblez `ldez rl ici vciwim e`ezez enetzim yazexd.
edpd rl fd `nxe afdx, c"lril`, aqhx` cwceyd ril`d, `iz inip` e`iz yn`l`", cdiipe, gqc ebaexd, tixey, cyzido do ncez `ldez lnrld nykl dpax`im edybzm, "c`ide ebxnedi gc" arelm d`vilez. e`s dybz nyd xaipe rlie dylem apae`ze, l` dizd arelm d`vilez, `l` rl ici dzlayeze arelm daxi`d. e`s bm f`z, l` ayzi ncez `le gqc ebaexd, `l` rl ici dzlayezo ancez ylnhd ndo ancxbd, ydo ncez pvg dec iqec kne ykzea ayrx dpae`d .
xw ynzo ykxm yl vciwim abo rco, de` dybz dztyhez dgiez e`ex dpnyj nyzi ncez `le gqc ebaexd, ede` nfeo pynez dvciwim yrqwe azexd lynd arelm dfd. ki ndztyhez yzi ncez `le, pnzg xwir rl dpynez yabo rco, exwir fd pwx` "xf` c`exiiz`", eae qec k"a `eziez dzexd, dpzepd nyzi ncez `le, kckzia: "ninipe `y cz lne", enxwir fd, pehs hl lnfeo dpynez, cdiipe, icirz qec k"a `eziez dzexd, ki dxwir dfd de` qec dcrz, edzexd di` nfeo dpynez abo rco, ednvez do laeyim, knae`x kl fd afdx eiwdl cs x"h ex"i, earu giim yrx n"c txw b' :
edpd, ym "`ldim", de` ym ncz dbaexd edvnvem, elko de` bm ko abinhxi` "dhar", lti ynqzix d`ex ylnrld dnded engid drelm, epx`d, k`ile drelm renc enzpdb acxj dhar. eym "`ldim" fd, de` nbo epxzw lym dei"d, ldrlim d`ex edgiez dpnyj nym dei"d ended n`io liy, yl` izbld lpax`im eiahle anvi`ez.
edxi agipz baexd fe evnvem dfd, de` bm ko agipz gqc ydrelm iapd ae, efe di` agipz baexd dkleld agqc.
edpd, ndzkllez dncez fe afe, px`d lrio c"`ide ebxnedi gc", ydo ncezie, ki n`gx ydo aigec bnex rne, lko do nziigcez fe afe eklelez fe nfe, kn`nx `lide: "e`pz de` cwyix leo enigc leo eke', eax nipj liz igec` aril`i ke'".
efde ykzea: "edyaez `l laaj, ki d' de` d`ldim", tixey, yypi ynez `le dm `gc nny, ybm ym "`ldim" dnvnvm enrlim d`ex, de` agipz gqc kne ym dei"d, nyem yncezie yl dwcey axej de` nzigcez rne aigec bnex, ede` eyne `gc, yncezie do ynezie.
e`m ko, nnil` zcr y"aynim nnrl erl d`xu nzgz `io rec", tixey, ybm d`xu dgenxiz ypx`iz iy bnex lrio kl, di` `io e`tq nny lbai dwcey axej de`, ki ym "`ldim" `ipe nrlim envnvm `l` lzgzepim, el` lbai dwcey axej de`, n`gx yde` eyne "`ldim" `gc, elko, bm d`xu enzgz l`xu do `io e`tq nny lbai dwcey axej de`, e`ipo pwx`ez aym kll, `tile aym "rec" yde` lyeo htl, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd "idecd erec lwx`", ekbes yde` htl lpynd egiez yazeke efde ykzea: "`dlld d' agii, `fnxd l`ldi areci", ydgiim pnykim nym dei"d, ed"rec" yde` dbes dhtl nym "`ldim" , lti ydpynd `ipd nded dbes n`io liy, `al dwcey axej de` dnded `z dkl n`io liy dkl ahl anvi`ez `vle, kne `ex dyny ayny.
elko devxj dkzea ldfdix "eicrz diem edyaez `l laaj ebe'", yl` zrld rl crzj ydynim ekl va`m ed`xu enle`d dm cax ptxc atpi rvne, edwcey axej de` nnl` kl drelm kdzlayez dpynd abes, enytir kg dveng a`xu, ekg dzperd ablblim, enpirm enpdibm kxvepe, kne ydpynd npird `z dbes enpdibze kxvepd.
`j a`nz, `io dnyl cend lpnyl kll, ki dpynd edbes dm a`nz ptxcim fd nfd ayxym, ki `io dzdeez yxy dbes ervneze npynze, `l` nhtez `aie e`ne, ebm `gxi ko, `io bicele npynze lacd, `l` rl ici `kilz eyziiz `ne kl zyrd gcyim, e`gx kj rl ici `kilze eyziize arvne, nd y`io ko dynim ed`xu, ykl rvnezm endezm pzded n`io e`tq dneglh xw acax d' exeg tie izaxj, ebm rciio pva cax d' lrelm, eyetr adm znic akl xbr, ended `ezm znic n`io liy, kdzdeez d`ex ndyny azej bes kcex dyny rvne cxj nyl, e`m ko, dm ahlim a`nz anvi`ez lbnxi lbai cax d' exeg tie izaxj, dniegcim andeze ervneze izaxj kne yiza`x lwno, kaihel `ex dyny ayny.
xw ydo do baexezie, ancz dbaexd edvnvem, ldqzix eldrlim dgiez dyetr adm, yidie px`im dynim ed`xu ekl va`m k`ile dm cax atpi rvne. `j `io dvnvem eddqzx `l` lzgzepim, `al lbai dwcey axej de` "kel` wnid kl` nny gyiai", k`ex dyny ayny, e`io ncz dbaexd nqzxz gq eylem ltpie izaxj, ki `ippd cax atpi rvne `l` "d' de` d`ldim":
eafd ieao nd ykzea afdx dwcey, ctqew "ynr iyx`l" de` "igec` ril`d", e"axej ym kaec nlkeze lrelm erc" de` "igec` zz`d", ki "erc" de` "`gc" agleti `zeeo.
ki dpd, qiaz ehrm dvnvem eddqzx dfd, ydqzix edrlim dwcey axej de` `z dgiez yl drelm kci yidid drelm px`d cax ptxc atpi rvne, dpd de` icer lkl, ki zkliz axi`z drelm de` ayail dzblez nlkeze izaxj, c"`io nlj al` rm", tixey "rm" nlyeo "rennez", ydm caxim ptxcim efxim exgewim nnrlz dnlj, ki `ile `tile die le apim xaim n`c l` yiij ym "nlekd" rlidm, eko `tile rl yxim lacm, xw "axea rm" ceew` "dcxz nlj".
eym dnexd rl ncz nlkeze izaxj, de` ym `cpez, ki de` `ceo kl d`xu. epnv`, ki ncd fe eym fd do dndeio enwiinio drelm, ldiez relm knez yde` rkyie, iy bnex ecax ptxc atpi rvne e`ipe ahl anvi`ez nny, ki adqzlwez ncd fe eym fd gq eylem, did drelm gefx lnwexe acax d' exeg tie izaxj, eahl ym anvi`ez nny, el` did ym "relm" rlie kll.
edpd, bcx eagipz ym "relm" petl rl agipz nwem eagipz fno cew`. agipz nwem de`: nfxg enrxa, vteo, cxem, nrld enhd. agipz fno rax, ded erzic.
edpd, kl agipez `le `io ldo yiikez ancez dwceyez drliepez, ki `m ancz nlkeze izaxj lacd, yiij lenx yde` izaxj nlj lnrld rc `io wu elnhd rc `io zkliz, eko lc' qhxio, eko aagipz fno "d' nlj, d' nlj, d' inlej" epnv`, ygiez dnwem eko giez dfno, edzdeezm n`io liy, ewienm kl fno wienm, de` nncz nlkeze izaxj eym `cpez axej de`.

kkd nny rl cxj nyl, dnacil daclez l`io wu, iy dtxy rvem n`c lnrld, aio kl va` dynim, e`tile dnl`kim, ypax`e n`io liy, egiim ewiinim nagipz givepiez dgiez edytr ynytir `io qes axej de` ldgiez drelnez, eagipd fe pwx`z aym "xeg tie" rl cxj nyl, kne ykzea: "eaxeg tie kl va`m", edi` agipz giez dnleayz a`eziez yaryxd n`nxez (ydo agipz klim ednykez eke', kne ypza`x alwehi `nxim glw a' txw i"`); eaio pynz d`cm, ypnykd zgld nagipz tpiniez dgiez edytr ynytir `io qes axej de`, kne ykzea: "eitg eke'", e`gx kj ixcd aqzx dncxbd, bm ko, rl ici agipz d`eziez yan`nx "pryd `cm" eke' kci ldzlay abes relm dfd dzgzeo.
elko pwx`e dnl`kim aym "`lwim" akzea, ekne ykzea: "ki d' `lwikm de` `lwi d`lwim be'" "dece l`lwi d`lwim be'" "eia`e api d`lwim ldziiva be'" lti yipiwz giezm di` nagipz givepiez ydi` agipz d`eziez lac, eym `lwim de` agipz givepiez lbai ym dei' axej de`.
`al pynz d`cm, ydi` nagipz tpiniez dgiez di` glw ym dei' axej de`, ki ym dei' nexd rl tpiniez dgiez, ydi` lnrld nrld nagipz d`eziez.
eai`ex drpio, kpecr nn`nx `lide: "`pz de` c`tiwz ryx ziwepio, ewxipo ldeo ryx qtixo, l`pdb` adeo rlnio qzinio eke'. ekl di' qtixez pkllez epxnfez aym dei' axej de`.
ki die"c, ydi` agipz pwecd lac, nxnfz lgknze izaxj, ydi` aagipz drlm edqzx wecm ya`d lagipz dztyhez ebilei ddybd eddapd (edweu yrl die"c xenf lagipz xveo drlieo axej de`, ylnrld nrld nncxbz agipz gknd ril`d, kpecr).
e`gx ya`d lagipz dztyhez ebilei ddybd eddapd lrlnio qzinio pkllz epxnfz a`ez d"`, yiy ld agipz dztyhez lxega, dnexd enxnf rl dxgaz dai`ex eddapd, ebm l`exj, dnexd rl agipz ddnykd eddytrd nlnrld lnhd lrlnio qzinio.
e`gx kj, kypnykz dnykd edytrd fe iezx lnhd lrlnio c`zbliio, ekne d`cm yxevd lblez gknze l`gxim rl ici ciaexe rl cxj nyl pkllz epxnfz dnykd fe a`eziez e"d.
ki dei"e nexd rl ddnykd nlnrld lnhd. ebm dnykd fe di` rl ici ncz gqce eheae ey`x ncezie dwceyez, dpkllez acxj kll anqtx yy, yatqew: lj d' dbceld eke'" rc "lj d' dnnlkd eke'", el` "rc" akll. ki ncz nlkeze izaxj pwx`z aym "cax d'", kne ykzea: "a`yx cax nlj ylheo".
epkllz epxnfz a`ez d"` `gxepd yl ym dei', ki tpiniez enwex dciaex, de` ddal dreld no dla enzglw ld' nev`ez dtd: `gd"r ndbxeo eke', ebm daxz dd"` di` agipz dal lac, kne ypwx`z: "`z` wlil` cliz ad nyy`".
e`s y`io le cnez dbes gq eylem, `j caxd zexd klyeo api `cm, aybm, ybm "cax d'" k"a `eziez, dnzglwez ld' glwi dnev`ez, eado pax` kl divex (ekne ypza`x alwehi `nxim glw a' txw i"`, ai`ex rpio `eziez `le).
ekkd nny rl cxj nyl, dnacil daclez l`io wu, apynz d`cm, ydi` agipz pty d`lwiz cnzekid ptg, iy ad agipz ykl dprlm, dnxenf a`ez ie"c, yakge lv`z `l dbilei, ldaio eldykil a`nzze izaxj eabcelze eke', kl gc egc ltem yirex` cilid, lti xega ykle eaipze.
ekti `yx nrniw ykle enxgia crze eaipze ldzaepo abcelze izaxj, `fi nxenfz aipze a`ez d"`, yiy ld xega, ebm `exj, dnexd rl ddnykd nlnrld lnhd, ldelic naipze edzaeppeze abcelz d' `dad eix`d ezelcezido anege ezrlenez lae, e`gx kj aagipz dzblez lae.
enfd pnykd raecd d`niziz arqw dzexd ednvez, awel ecaex `e nryd, do `eziez e`"e d"` eke'.
ebm ddzaeppez ldaio eldykil a`nzze ebcelze izaxj, pnykd bm ko ndzexd, c`exiiz` ngknd ptw`, di` agipz ie"c yl ym dei' eke':
edpd, dnykz eixicz dpty d`lwiz lrelm dfd ldzlay abes d`cm, pnykd nagipz tpiniez enwex dciaex, de` dal drlieo, dnxenf a`ez d"` zz`d kpfkx lril, ekne ykzea: "eitg a`tie pynz giim, eidi d`cm lpty gid", e"n`o cptg eke'".
efde ykzea: "ki glw d' rne, irwa gal pglze", tixey, kne gal, rl cxj nyl, yx`ye `gc wyex lnrld ewvde lnhd.
ki dpd, tyh dkzea nd ykzea "eitg", de` ldexez lpe, kne yrl cxj nyl kyd`cm petg l`ifd nwem, `m iy `ifd cax gevu entqiw aipziim `io dal dpetg reld enbir kll l`eze nwem, kkd nny, `m iy cax gevu entqiw aio bes d`cm lagipz dal drlieo.
`j a`nz, `io yem cax byni exegpi gevu ltpie izaxj, ki "dl` `z dynim e`z d`xu `pi nl`", e"nl` kl d`xu kaece", e"liz `zx tpei nipid", "aynim nnrl erl d`xu nzgz `io rec", e"`ide nnl` kl rlnio eke'".
`l` kne ykzea aiyrid: "ki `m reepezikm die nacilim aipikm laio `lwikm". edhrm, lti ydm pbc xveo drlieo axej de` dngid `z dkl, kne ykzea: "kl `yx gtu d' ryd aynim ea`xu" (ekne ypza`x lril, yde` nwex dytrz ym dei', epxnf aweve yl ie"c).
efde rpio dkxz, ypkxz eptqw gal ddnykd nym dei' axej de`, ypnykd nd"` zz`d kpfkx lril, ekne ykzea atxyz `nex: "epkxzd dpty ddi` nltpi, `pi d'" "nltpi" ciiw`.
eay`x raixez y`io ado kxz rl kl tpim do tebnio dpty, kpecr; etbm, de` nlyeo tbinz dqkio.
ede` rl cxj nyl, ngal ra yfex nzxi"b galim cwim, kkd gal ddnykd dpfkx lril klel nzxi"b nvez, ekyreax gq eylem rl `gz ndpd ptqw gal dcw eke'.
`j bm agiia kxz enizd py`x rciio ae dxyine nptye d`lwiz, erl ici fd ikel lgiez rc p' `e q' ypd el` iezx (end ykzea aym d`xif"l ypkpqd ae agipz dnwis eke' `ipe rpio lgii byniez dbes, eniixi rc p' ypd, `e afno dfd kclwno):
`npm, fde afno ydie iyx`l ancxbd rliepd, kydizd dykipd yexd aiyx`l aaiz dnwcy, e`f, l` die nwalim giez lbetm, xw rl ici pty d`lwiz lacd, nagipz tpiniez dytr ynytir `io qes axej de` rl ici ym dei' axej de`, kpfkx lril.
`j l`gx yixce nncxbzm, ebxne anryidm qec blez dykipd, kne ykzea: "eatyrikm yelgd `nkm", cdiipe, yixcd dytrz agipz d"` zz`d dpfkxz lril, epyzlyld nncxbd lncxbd lnhd nhd, rc ypzlayd dytrzd ai' qtixez cpebd, dnytirez ytr egiez rl ici dnflez ekl va` dynim edyxim yrlidm, lkl dgi dbyni yarelm dfd, ebm lkl dveng, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io lj kl rya nlnhd y`io le nfl eke'".
e`fi, ikel bm dgeh` eteyri iyx`l lwal giez lbetm eptym dadniez kne y`x arli giim nny, kne ykzea: "pnyl kadnez pcne".
e`cxad, aizx y`z eizx rf, rl ti dnae`x nfedx dwcey txyz tweci, ykl ytr egiez dpytrez l`cm dzgzeo ayrd exbr yreyd dxr aripi d' anryd `e aciaex `e adxdexi raixd eke', dkl pytr le ndiklez dqhx` `gx` dnae`xim ym afedx dwcey.
ed`cm de` arl agixd, `m lwal dytrze ndiklez dqhx` `gx`, `e ndiklez dwceyd yndm pytrez kl ngyaez heaez ewceyez eke'.
ki "fd lrenz fd ryd d`lwim" eke'. ediklez dqhx` `gx` nwalim eiepwim giezm ndzlayez edyzlylez dytr ci' qtixez cpebd, dkleld nagipz hea exr, di` agipz "ru dcrz" eke', kpecr liecri go.
edpd, "irwa gal pglze" kzia: rl cxj nyl, kne dgal yx`ye `gc lnrld ex`ye dypi lnhd, `m inyej `cm ax`ye dypi iprpr einyj `gxie bm x`ye dx`yeo knd y`tyx le ldnyj.
ekkd nny ayxy pynz d`cm enwexd nagipz d"` zz`d dpfkxz lril, de` nnyij enexic dytrzd rl ici nryie dxrim engyaezie rc zej diklez dqhx` `gx` kaikel, ynym nwal ngyaezie enryie. entpi yde` de` dnnyij ldm ddytrd, lko de` pehl glw ax`y, eci lnaio.
efde y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io aicipe l` nylez dxyrim eke'" "aicipe" cew`, klenx, afno dblez `gx dgexao. efedi agipz blez dykipd kaikel, ldytir ldiklez dqhx` `gx` `yx yp`d ptye izaxj.
ekyd`cm reyd zyead pkepd `fi nqlw ndm ddytrd ydnyij anryie engyaezie, ki azyeaze ngfix dytrz dykipd lnwend.
efde zyea d"` zz`d nagipz blez, ekne ykzea: "eya d' `lwij `z yaezj", klenx rm yaezj, ekn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "edyia l` p`nx eke'":
e`elm, cxj d`nz ediyx lagipz zyead zz`d, d"` zz`d dpfkxz lril dm a' caxim cxj kll.
d`gc, de` lrexx xgnim drliepim nnwex dxgnim rl pynze eptye d`lwiz, yptld "n`ibx` xnd" gii dgiim axej de` l"aix` rniwz`", do diklez dhen`d edqhx` `gx`, erl nwexd anwex dgiim, de` ym dei' axej de`; ekne ykzea: "eiyea `l dei' eixgnde", tixey, lrexx xgnim rl dytrz ym dei' axej de`, ypyzlyld eixcd zej diklez dqhx` `gx` dhn`im ldgiezm, rl ici nryd `pey ezgaelezie, engyaezie dxrez; ekne ykzea: "nlj `qex axdhim" axdihi neg` eke' di` agipz blez dykipd, kpfkx lril.
efno dnqebl lfd, de` aziweo gvez, kne ykzea aqicex adrxd, riio ym a`xikez. efde ykzea ym: "ptld rhxz x`yipe, `ei p` lpe ki gh`pe".
elko pwx` dwcey axej de` "nlj rlea" atxwi diklez, kne ykza dxn"w fkxepe laxkd, ki `io lj rlaeo bcel nfd, eatxh k`yx izaepo dnykil abcelz `io qes axej de`, nnl` kl rlnio eqeaa kl rlnio, kl `gc e`gc lti yirex ykle edapze, iznxnx rl fd n`c n`c.
eda', lahy eldkpir dwlitd eqhx` `gx`, `yx kl giezd di` xw agipz bqez edbadd, kne ykzea: "`m zbaid kpyx ebe'", edaihey eddkprd rc rtx nny fedi nizzd eaiheld.
ediipe, rl ici "la pyax epckd", eldiez "pafd aripie pn`q" eke', ekne ykzea afedx dwcey rl tqew: "fagi `lwim xeg pyaxd, la pyax epckd eke'", ki kl wxao no dadnd de` lym dei', di` ncz dxgnim, `al lym `lwim, di` ncz dcio `io nwxiaio wxao adnd, ki `m lyax eldraix xeg dhen`d edqhx` `gx`, efde "xeg pyaxd".
ed`ij pyaxd xeg dqhx` `gx`? kyd"la pyax epckd" eke'.
ed`ij pyax dla epckd? dpd, nrh nfrix de` rl ici qibetim ezrpiez, acexezipe `ld y`io lpe kg ldzrpez dxad kcec dnlj, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd rl tqew: "elai gll awxai" y"dxbe azrpiz".
`j riwx dkprz dla, ldiez pyax epckd edraxz xeg dhen`d eqhx` `gx`, de` ldiez n"n`xi cgeyap`" arenw dcrz, ldrniw crze eaipze yrd `gz akl iem `e lild ltpi ziweo gvez, ldzaepo and ytrl eryd agh`ie agipz blez dykipd kpfkx lril, ebxm lrwex pynze eptye d`lwiz ngii dgiim axej de`, edexicd lnwem dhen`d ednez, do diklez dqhx` `gx`, epryiz aagipz nxkad `lidm lwal ndm ytr egiez ldytir lbete, kpfkx lril.
efde y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "xyrim agiidm wxeiim nzim", klenx, ygiidm pnykim nnwem dnez edhen`d, (eko nd ykzea: "l` dnzim idlle ebe'", `ipe k"lerb lxy" gq eylem `l` dkeepd rl dxyrim yagiidm wxeiim nzim, ynalalim `ezm angyaez fxez arecm axyrm e`ipm gtivim azyead, kpecr).
e`s ni yl` rax rl reo kxz, ebm l` rl reo nizd aici ynim yde` dev`z fxr lahld ekd`i bep`, `l` y`x raixez wlez, `s rl ti ko, n`gx ydo tebnim apynd epty d`lwiz, eknyl tbinz etqiwz galim cwim kpfkx lril, dxi axiaei dgh`im ikel ldiez tbm kne al`e `gc yiy ae kxz `e nizd, e`tile aktilz gh` `gc trnim xaez n`c.
kne ydnyil dpai` dgh`im lrpo dn`til `ex dyny, kne ykzea: "ngizi kra tyrij" dm raixez gnexez, dnacilim aio tpiniz dytrz ym dei' axej de` lpty d`lwiz, kdaclz rpo ra egyej, dnacil aio dyny l`xu elcxim rlid rl cxj nyl: ekrpo gh`zij do "raixez wlez y`cm cy arwaie", dnacilim kdaclz rpo wl ewley rl cxj nyl.
edpd, kne yanyl dfd, `m nyim `cm pbc `ex dyny agleo ngivez wlez ewleyez lxea n`c, do n`tilez kne ngivd `gz rad eiezx ekkd nny de` apnyl akl repez y`cm cy arwaie. enkl yko dntexqnez ncaxi xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, ydo nny kraecd fxd ebilei rxiez eytikez cnim.
kne drlnz rio no dvcwd, kne ykzea: "dynx lj to idid cax rm laaj alirl ebe'", e"alirl", di` reac raecz `lilim eke', ednqtx abpez gaixe, di` lyeo dxr, dyweld kraecd fxd ebilei rxiez eytikez cnim, ekl dkerq k`le reac raecd fxd, eko ni yiy ae bqez dxeg, ekdpd xaez abnx`. ezlnec zexd kpbc kelo, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "eizx dwcey axej de` rl raecd fxd eke'".
elko qicxe awxi`z ynr yrl dnhd, lwal rlie c' nizez aiz cio eke'. nlac, yrl ti dqec, kl dtebm a`ez ie"c yl ym dei' k`ile pzgiia qwild, edtebm a`ez d"` k`ile pzgiia yxitd, ea`ez ei"e k`ile pzgiia dxb, ea`ez d"` `gxepd k`ile pzgiia gpw: ednahl wxi`z ynr tebm a`ez ie"c, eztilio a`ez d"`, eviviz a`ez ei"e, eztld a`ez d"` eke'.
enfd ikel dnykil llnec ly`x repez egh`im, eaihel zexd kpbc kelo:
edpd, `gxi drnwz dcrz akl dpfkx lril, iekl lawy a`nz, nrenw` cla` "kxea xgnij ngd tyri ebe'". ki `fi zwar alae a`nz becl dxgnpez rl agipz `lwez yaptye eylnrld, kpfkx lril. eafd irexx xgnim drliepim ni"b ncez dxgnim, dpnykez nxveo drlieo axej de`, dpxnf aweve yl ie"c, ylnrld nrld nagipz ddytrd dpytrz n`eziez ym dei'.
elko di"b ncez dxgnim npwim kl dtbnim, ekne ykzea: "pey` reo etyr epwd", eyea `io ipiwd ldgivepim edqhx` `gx` ndytrz d"` zz`d, kpfkx lril (eafd zyea d"` zz`d lnwend, ldziigc aid"e, eci lnaio).
eko nny lnhd apty d`lwiz ya`cm, yea `io "repezikm nacilim", ekne ykzea "epwd" "npwd de` lyaim", lxgeu elpwez ptym nlaeyim dve`im, dm dgivepim eqhx` `gx`, kne ykzea abnx` "nlttze eke'".
en`gx y"xeg raxd ezhdxm", `fi zekl ptym lyea rc dei' axej de` nny, elrlez nrld nrld lnwexd, elcawd ae izaxj aigec ptl`, kne ydizd niegcz ae izaxj azkliz digec, ahxm yptgd axeg tie izaxj lixc lnhd eldzlay abes d`cm (ekne rl cxj nyl, a`cm dpetg axeg tie, ahxm yiev` dxeg ntie de` niegc aptye). efe di` zyead ylind.
edpd, agipz igec fd ezyead fe, di` agipz zyead ril`d yl`gx zyead zz`d, ekne ykzea afedx dwcey axri` ndinp` txyz py`, czyead ril`d di`, cizrqw a`exiiz` acgile exgine cwecy` axij de` eke', c`ide ao i"d aipd eke' (enrlz arli zyead rl vciwim bnexim afd di`, kne ykzea afedx dwcey txyz gii yxd, c`ipeo nyki rliide axrez` cla` izix eagil` qbi l`zwxa` lnlk` eke'):
eai`ex drpio, kne ykzea afedx dwcey eziwepim aknd nwenez, caipd `idi zyead ril`d, "ed`m xeavz rl d`txegim" eke'.
cdiipe, yrl ici ynzaepo abcelz d' adrnwz dcrz, enelic nxeg aipze cgile exgine ykliim, eahea hrm ecrz, krpio yp`nx: "l`dad `z d' `lwij", nyem "ki de` giij ebe'", el` ci le a`dad hariz dnqezxz lac eke', eko aix`d etgc `e aeyd eke', kpecr `fi pwx`z "d`m xeavz rl d`txegim" eke'.
edpd, riwx d`dad di` "`zcawez xeg` axeg`" kne ykzea: "iywpi npyiwez tide ebe'", kpecr. erl fd p`nx: "eakl ptyj", ydm dm kl glwi dpty: ykl encez, elaeyidm: ngyad ciaex enryd, lcawd kelo ae izaxj.
cdiipe, dncez ancezie izaxj, "nd de` xgem eke'".
edykl aykle egknze izaxj, de` rieo dzexd, c"`exiiz` ngknd ptw`":
eko dngyad angyaze izaxj: edciaex acax d', fe dlkd, ekne ykzea: "e`yim caxi atij", "ecaxi `yx ynzi atij":
ednryd de` nryd dvcwd, ldgiez xeg ytlim, kne ykzea: "ki yyz inim ryd d' ebe'", kpecr anwem `gx.
efe di` "`zcawez cxeg` axeg`" azkliz dcaiwez edigec, kydi` ngnz `dad eke'. elti ytbm daxiz adev`z fxr lahld, e`io vxij lenx arxiez, `e y`x `iqexi ai`d c`exiiz` `e cxapo (ki gnexim caxi qetxim eke') tebm aneg, lko ziwepe de` cizrqw a`exiiz`, cngknd ptw`.
efde ykzea azp` cai `lide: "`cm rax raixd epzgiia nizd lnwem, nd iryd eigid? `m did xbil lwxez cs `gc iwx` a' ctim, lypez txw `gc iypd a' txwim eke'". ediipe, knyl gal dptqw egefx eweyxe, yanwem dwyx de` ktel enketl, ekkd de` a"gal pglze" eke'.
efde y`nx dkzea: "agqc e`nz iketx reo ebe'", "e`io `nz `l` zexd eke'".
e"reo aiz rli afag enpgd de` c`ipe nzktx `al nzktx azexd ebnilez gqcim", kc`iz` aqes txw wn` cx`y dypd:
edpd, zyead ril`d fe, c`zcawez` cxeg` axeg` rl ici zexd ebnilez gqcim, di` aagipz dnykd nlnrld lnhd, ldiez cax d' nny atie, ekne ykzea: "e`yim caxi atij", "einipe zgawpi" abnilez gqcim, c"gqc cxer` inip` eke'".
`al `cm dzgzeo vxij lilj nncxbd lncxbd nnhd lnrld, di` agipz zyead ril`d e`zcawez xeg` axeg`, akeepz dla aztld, eatxh awxi`z ynr eaxkezid, kci lenx: "e`daz ebe' akl laaj eakl ptyj ebe'", a`nz l`nize: eko: "edie dcaxim d`ld ebe', ecaxz am ebe'", ldiez cax d' atie a`nz, "e`io `nz eke'":
eko lwiim kl dnvez, kne y`enxim: "`yx wcype anvezie", kne: "dxi `z nwecyz li", di` agipz wcy drlieo, lyeo txiyez edacld, y`ipe ikel ldzlay zej rlnio, nyem c"kel` wnid kl` gyia", `l` aagipz qeaa kl rlnio, de` xveo drlieo axej de` eke', kne ypza`x alwehi `nxim txw n"e.
ebm `gx dztld `enxim: "`lij d' ptyi `y`", cdiipe, l`zcaw` xeg` axeg` kl diem eke'. ekl fd, rl ici ddzaeppez abcelz `io qes axej de` adrnwz dcrz, a"yzim ltpid" ea"tqewi cfnxd", kpecr.

tixy ylnd dnlj rlie dylem "gbxd aref nzpid ke'" "nzpim", dm agipz cax dnrnic kl dbes rm dx`y dpva erenc rlidm, edm dnelikim enai`im `eze lngef gtve.

e"knim dtpim ke'" ldelic nzaepd fe cgile exgine ykliim `e hariim, ldiez agipz "vrw lam `l d'", `e agipz xyti `y eyldaz rfd, aagipz "xve`", e`gx kj aagipz "yea", ldiez tgc d' alae eliaey nbcelze ke', ede` agipz "yn`l cegd", kne ykzea anzo zexd "eix` drm eipere eirnce nxgew ke'", edo agipez dfxerez edbes yapty:
`j ni de` dpezo kg eref lagipz "nzpim", ldrnic elwiim dx`y edfxerez? de` rqw elinec dlkez azexd yarl td, ydi` agipz bilei xveo drlieo, c`exiiz` ngknd di` cptwz, `al nwexd eyxyd de` lnrld nrld nagipz gknd, ede` dpwx` aym "xveo drlieo" axej de`, ekne ykzea "kvpd xveo zrhxpe" krhxd ydi` rl dnegio yax`y, ekpecr nnd ytixye rl tqew "`yz gil rhxz arld"; e"kl dyepd dlkez akl iem ke'".

"whpzi nkl dgqcim enkl ke'". tixey, yakl gqc egqc ydwcey axej de` reyd l`cm vxij ldiez ytl xeg an`c. ki gqc cxer` inip`, "einipe zgawpi", ydi` agipz wxaz `ldim nny aizx y`z nltpim, ekl dwxea `l d' aizx y`z edbad lnrld nrld, vxij ldiez iezx ytl xeg lnhd nhd, kne ykzea "nxgew d' px`d li". ekpecr, ckel` "wnid" ceew` kl` gyia, e`m ko, kl yde` "wnid" iezx de` iezx kl` e`io e`tq.

`j kci yl` ipwe dgivepim lnrld n`ex eytr dnyzlyl eiexc lnhd nhd rc relm dfd dbyni, eko lnhd ldbio rl d`cm elynxe eldvile nkl cax xr abyniez eaxegpiez, lf`z, gefx en`ix `ex dnwis eqezm dpwa, rl cxj nyl, ki de` nagipz `io qes eqeaa kl rlnio kpfkx lril. efde y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "nvhxtz lgyaeo bcel" ciiw`, "ki bcel d' endell n`c", ali qes ezkliz ebael gq eylem :
`j ni de` dbexm lixicz d`ex edytr lrelm dfd dbyni ni' qtixez dpwx`im "bet`", de` digec dpfkx lril, ydi` zeqtz d`xd edytrd nagipz `ex `io qes dn`vil drlieo axej de`, aizx y`z rl dd`xd eddytrd yazgilz d`vilez eddyzlylez eke'. ex`yiz zeqtz dd`xd eddytrd, di` lx`yiz di' qtixez.

`io iyx`l pb`lio `l` avcwd, yp`nx "eyaid avcwd". kzia: "vcw ltpie idlj", eded lid lninx: "ilj". `j drpio, rl ti nd ykzea "lj `nx lai awye tpi", tixey, awye tpiniz dla. ki dpd, alda iqec d`y d`lwiz yala (peqg `gx: dpd, adla iqec d`y d`lwiz yala ) iy a' agipez: agipz givepiez, eagipz tpiniez.

efd lrenz fd, kkd de` nny araecd yala. ediipe, lti yagipz pwecz tpiniz dla di` lnrld nagipz dcrz dnztyh enzlay ancez ypelce ngknd aipd crz kpecr, xw di` agipz d`xz gknd rliepd ylnrld ndaipd edcrz, ead nleay ebpef `ex d' nny, kne ykzea "d' agknd ke'", edi` di` agipz piveu `lwez yakl pty niyx`l.

edpd, anild iy ypi agipez: nild etxird, ydo rxld bqd ewlitd cwd. eko arxlz dla iy bm ko z`ez bqez ecwez nild etxird; e"nl el` txr k`le l` nl", ntpi yqes qes rciio pwecz tpiniz dla di` nkeqd alaey yw cw, aagipz blez eyaid.
edpd, rl nilz drxld nny kzia "enlzm `z rxlz laakm" `zm arvnkm. `j ldqix dwlitd dcwd, fde cax dwyd rl d`cm, erl fd p`nx aai`z dnyig: "enl d' `ldij `z laaj ke', l`dad `z d' `ldij akl laaj eakl ptyj lnro giij", klenx lnro ki d' lace de` kl giij nny, ylko `dad fe di` nrenw` cla` npwecd tpiniz nny kpfkx lril, elnrld nagipz dcrz.
elko nyig a` adiqg dcrz lkllez iyx`l, edi` bilei agipz pwecd tpiniz dklliz, eivi`z dykipd dklliz ndblez edyaid, lrc elrelni relnim. eko, kl piveu txhi ndykipd yapty kl `gc niyx`l iev`z ndblez edyaid lti yrd, a"gii yrd" fe ztld, eraecd yala nrenw` cla`, nagipz pwecd dtpiniz dpbliz ndrxld, ereld lnrld, lcawd ae azyewd rfd aagipz "lnro giij".
ede` bm ko aagipz diqg crz d`cm, ki agipd fe di` lnrld ncrz d`cm edzaeppeze abcelz d', xw di` agipz nzpd pzepd n`z d' no dynim, nd`xz agipz tpim drliepim, kne ykzea "i`x d' tpie `lij", ekne ykzea: "enl d' `lwij" ke'.
`j necrz f`z, ki "`zrxez` clril`" di` a"`zrxez` clzz`" cew`, aagipz drl`z "niio pewaio", kne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd "`io htd iexcz nlnrld ke'". elko vxij d`cm lryez arvne zglz nild fe, ldqix rxlz dla ewlitd dbqd ecwd, dnlaiyez enkqez rl agipz pwecz tpiniz dla, ydi` agipz `daz d', agipz "lnro giij", ydi` ablez az`eez relm dfd, ydm bm ko aagipz "lnro giij" a"fd lrenz fd", kpfkx lril.
ediipe, rl ici pzipz dvcwd ld' nnnepe, yde` gieze. eatxh ni ynfepezie nvenvnim ecgiw` lid yrz` hea`, ypezo ngiie nny. eatxhez `m pdpd nibir ktie, y`i `tyx yl` rqw adm trnim xaez aagipz pwecz tpiniz dla nrenw` cla`, knpdb drelm arqwidm any` enzo ekd`i bep`.
edxi rzd dtrm kyntfx nibire epezo ld' ayngd eahea laa dpd afd tecd ptye nygz, cdiipe agipz pwecz tpiniz laae, ydizd aagipz blez eyaid azej dwlitd bqd `e cwd, kne ykzea, "nkl nynx pvex laj" "nynx" tixey aiz d`qexim, erzd, ptcd ndgivepim avcwd fe. efd bm ko lyeo "txird" rpio txirz gea, ypzgiia epyzrac lgivepim ynyle ae rl pwecz tpiniez laae, efde "eyaid avcwd".
efde "vcw ltpie idlj", "ltpie" de` nlyeo tpiniez, e"idlj" de` nlyeo delkd, ynelij `z tpiniz dla ld', e`gx kj "iyim lcxj" d' "trnie", kne ykzea: "edlkz acxkie", "`gxi d' `ldikm zlke", akl nryd dnvez, ezlnec zexd kpbc kelo, ykelo relio ld' rl ici tpiniz dla, aizx y`z enrld nrld nrliizo ld' rl ici givepiz dla, dpelc ndzaepd edcrz laco, ali d`xz tpim nlnrld `l` aagipz dqzx tpim, ki `io dtpim drliepim n`ixim lnhd `l` a`zrxez` clzz`, anryd dvcwd dpwx` "ylem". efde ykzea: "tcd aylem ptyi" "ptyi" ciiw`.
efde bm ko dhrm ypwx` dvcwd "ylem", lti y"pryd ylem aio iyx`l l`aidm yaynim" kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, cdiipe rl ici tcieo ptyezido, dm glw d' nny, nici dgivepim, eatxh vcwz `xu iyx`l, ydi` vcwz d' nny, kne ykzea: "znic ripi d' `ldij ad", "edie ripi elai ym kl dinim".
edi` yrncd lpe ltcez gii ptype nrvz dgeyaim lcgez trnipe, ezrnec lpe lrc, lyem ptype agiim `nizim, ngii dgiim, "l`ex a`ex dgiim", `yx "i`x d' tpie `zpe qld", `no ko idi xveo:
eiry cec ym. etixy afedx dwcey, nyem yp`nx: "eidi cec reyd nyth evcwd lkl rne ke'", "akd xai ynreo e`nx: n`o raic yn` wciy` akl ien` n`o cidia vcwd lnqkpi ke'".
eieao, adwcim n`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd rl tqew: "ki aid d' vex relnim" "ad' pax` relm dfd, aie"c pax` relm da`". tixey, ydzrpeb ynzrpbim pynez dvciwim epdpio nfie dykipd dn`ix abo rco rlieo ezgzeo, de`, ynzrpbim adybzm edyklzm, ynykilim eiecrim enyibim `ifd dybd a`ex egiez dyetr ym n`io qes axej de`, aagipz bilei lpynzm exeg aipzm, ldaio eldyib `ifd dybd kl `gc e`gc lti ncxbze elti nryie, elko pwx` relm da` aym "aipd" afedx dwcey.
edytrd fe pnykz nagipz gknd ril`d, yde` nwex ddykld eddybd dpwx` aym aipd, ede` wcnez dykl wecm ya` lkll bilei dybd edapd, xw rciio de` aagipz drlm edqzx, xw ynrh nfrix ym frix ym yetr epnyj nym lagipz aipd, ldaio eldyib ykl dprlm, elko pwx` aym "pwecd adikl`" afedx dwcey, efe di` znepz ie"c yl ym dei' axej de`. epwx` "rco", `yx rlie p`nx: "rio l` x`zd" ke'. epwx` "`a` iqc axz`".
tixey, ki dpd dzdeez `eziez dcaex diev`ez nd' nev`ez dtd `ipo cax neykl el` nehar ahar nev`ez dlle, ldevi` nah` d`eziez rl ici ddal edwel dnkd ado rl ti cxj dhar el` rl ti cxj dykl. kbeo dytzim, rl cxj nyl, y`eziez aen"t iev`ez ndo, `io dhar el` dykl pezo livi`z nah` `xar glwi yipeii aihei `eziez `le, rl ti yipeii zperz dytzim, ynzperprez adal `gc ewel `gc dtebr ado ayed, e`cxad, yipei dzperez yaytzim de` lti yipei aihei d`eziez yaxveo dpty, lah` aytzim kxvepd, lenx `ez a' `e e' `e n' `e t'. el` lditj, yidid xveo dpty ekepzd lryez yipei zperez dytzim kne ydo nzprprez rzd aaiheii c' `eziez `le, ekpx`d agey, y`io dpty nzkeepz eiecrz lkeio kll yipei zperez dytzim ayipeiim `le.
eiezx px`d ko aaihei dpwecez, ykydpty xvepd ldevi` ntid pwecz wnu `fi nnil` pwnvim dytzim, eatzg ptzgim dytzim, el` yxveo dpty lwneu el` ltzeg kll ekll. e`io ld`xij acax dtyeh eneao eneykl lkl nykil, ynah` d`eziez edpwecez de` lnrld ndykl dneyb eneao, `l` nykl dprlm ewcnez dykl yapty dncaxz, elko `io dzipew ikel lcax, `s ynaio dkl:
`j d`eziez do aagipz genx evexd, dpwx` tpiniz egivepiz, ki dbm ynwexo de` nwcnez dykl exveo dpty, fe di` agipz vexz yipei dnah` yak"a `eziez, `al agipz dgenx ebes dzdeezo, ede` agipz givepiezo, de` ddal diev` ndla, ynnpe nzded wel tyeh diev` ndbxeo, e`gx kj pglw lk"a daxez, eaihei k"a `eziez ad' nev`ez dicerez: `gd"r ndbxeo, bik"w ndgij ke'. enah` ddal de` `ez d' "`z` wlil` ke'", ede` nwex dgenx ebes d`eziez hxm dzglwezo lk"a, elko `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, y"relm dfd pax` ad'":
edpd, dbm ydi` d' zz`d, d' `gxepd yaym dei', exaezipe fkxepm laxkd cxye fd rl tqew: "ki aid", diipe lti ynwexd ex`yizd la` lagipz bilei ndrlm die"c de` neytr epnyj nagipz d' ril`d, yiy ld dztyhez `exj exega, ldexez rl agipz aipd, ydi` dztyhez dykl dprlm aagipz bilei edybd adxgaz dcrz, edytrzd nqziinz ala, ekne ykzea aziwepim, c"aipd la`, ead dla naio", enym iev` ddal nwex bilei bes d`eziez dcaex, dnzblez ad' nev`ez ndrlm die"c.
eznepz d' zz`d akziazd bm ko adztyhez `exj exega, nexd rl dztyhez agipz nlkeze izaxj, "nlkez kl relnim", lnrld elnhd elc' qhxio, dnztyhez epnykez n`eziez cax d', kne ykzea awdlz: "a`yx cax nlj ylheo", kne ynae`x anwem `gx.
eldaio nrh nfrix rpio endez `eziez dcaex a`ldez, y`io le cnez dbes el` dpty gq eylem, kax pza`x acxj `xekd ewvxd (alwehi `nxim glw a txwim i"` ei"a, riio ym) :
`j ai`ex drpio, lnd `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd yrelm dfd cew` pax` ad'? dpd icer lkl gkni la, ki xiaei drelnez eddiklez `yx `io ldm nqtx, kne ykzea: "diy nqtx lbcecie", eakl dikl ebcec `ls `ltio exae` xaao nl`kim, eko pty xeg pynd gid igicd ncxbez l`io wu, eakl relm ediklez nxiaei diklez ya`vilez axi`d ivixd.
dpd kl xiaeiim `le, xiaei `gx xiaei rc `io wu nny, dkl pnyj epytr nxiaei vixeti k"a `eziez cax d', dnzglwez bm ko lvixetim xaim rc `io wu ezkliz nny, kne ykzea aqtx ivixd: "yard `apim aepez gnyz `ltim e`xarim azim, nk`o e`ilj v` egyea nd y`io dtd ikel lcax ke'".
edbm yiy anrlez encxibez dnl`kim epynez knd eknd nipi nrlez encxibez glewez l`io wu, baed rl baed dpd dkl pnyj lti gileti dvixetim edznexez a`"z a"y ke' (ekne ypza`x atxw i"a). `j cxj kll, dpd kelm arli gknd ecrz, eiecrim `z aex`m, ntpi diez giezm ntpiniez d`eziez dpnykez nagipz gknd ril`d, ekpfkx lril.
`j drelm dfd dytl, rm dgiez yazeke, who ndkil elqael `ex egiez nagipz vexz d`eziez etpiniezo, ld`ix eldytir ae ali laey edqzx kne yn`ixez enytirez lpynez enl`kim, xw dd`xd eddytrd a`d epytr lrelm dfd nagipz genx ebes d`eziez egivepiezm, yde` agipz ddal, dnzglw lf' dalim yawdlz yrlidm drelm renc, kne ykzea afedx dwcey.
ede` "nev` ti d'" dnzlay arelm dfd ekl va`ie ldgiezm, eazeke nleayz agipz vexz `eziez dcaex edngyad, nncezie dwceyez exvepe egknze eke', dniegcez a`io qes axej de` azkliz (efde y`nx d`x"i fkxepe laxkd, yagipz givepiez dklim cnlkez c`vilez, dnxenfez ad' yl ym dei' axej de`, dm ixce eprye pynd lrelm dryid). eko kzea azwepim ydie"c de` a`vilez ke', ed' zz`d nwppz aryid:
edpd, a`cm dzgzeo lnyl, ni yde` gkm bcel ldykil ptl`ez gknd, envnvm ykle engyaze a`ez `gc ncaexe, dpd fd de` vnvem rvem eixicd bceld lgknze dptl`d, kkd nny rl cxj nyl, eizx nfd l`io wu did vnvem bcel rvem exa, k`yx "acax d' ynim prye", ayyz ini ax`yiz, "eaxeg tie kl va`m", di` `ez d' yl ym dei' axej de`, "`z` wlil`", kne ykzea: "adax`m" "ad' ax`m", di` nwex dh' n`nxez ypnyke nn`nx x`yeo "ax`yiz" c"pni n`nx de`", di` agipz gknd dpwx`z "x`yiz".
`j `f dizd dnykd eixicd fe ali `zrxez` clzz` kll, ki "`cm `io lraec ke'", xw "ki gtu gqc de`", e"relm gqc iapd". efde "adax`m" "a`axdm", ki "gqc l`axdm" ke'.
`j `gx axi`z d`cm "lracd ke'", `fi kl `zrxez` clril` lrexx ncz gqc rlieo, de` a`zrxez` clzz`, avcwd egqc yiyx`l reyio arelm dfd. lko `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: kl d`enx `io le `l` zexd ali bnilez gqcim, `tile zexd `io le, `l` lrqew azexd eabnilez gqcim.
ki dpd, dbm c"`exiiz` ngknd ptwz", ea`exiiz` nzwiim rln` ea`ipeo clr`o ad, ki acaexm nnyikim d`xez edytrez (peqg `gx: edyx`ez) gknd ril`d, nwex dzexd lagipz `eziez dcaex yado pax` drelm, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`l zwxi apij `l` aepij" dxi dnykd fe di` agipz ixicd bceld, elfd vxij lrexx gqc rlieo, dpnyj knim nnwem baed lnwem pnej, a`zrxez` clzz`, avcwd egqc zz`d, ynnyikim giim egqc, ldgiez xeg ytlim epck`im.
efde ykzea: "`l izdll gkm agknze ke', ki `m af`z izdll ke', ki `pi d' reyd gqc ke'", ki dgqc de` dnnyij gii dgknd lnhd, e`m l`e, dxi pwx`z "gknze" lace, ali dnykz giim nnpd gq eylem.
eafd ieao nd y`nx d`xif"l, yiy a' nipi pynez aiyx`l pynez zlnici gknim dreqwim azexd kl inidm, epynez arli nvez dreqwim avcwd ebnilez gqcim. clk`exd, dxi bm zlnici gknim vxikim lrqew abnilez gqcim, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, y"`tile zexd `io le".
`l` ydzlnici gknim yzexzo riwx exea inidm ad, enireh inidm abnilez gqcim, dpd trelz `zrxezm clzz` lrexx gqc rlieo, ldnyij eldexic `ex `io qes dnleay agknd ril`d, nwex zexz d' yatidm, de` xw lrelm dpynez yaaxi`d rl ici rqw dzlnec, elnl`kim yaivixd rl ici linec dnypd, iro diez giez dpynez ednl`kim pytrez nvixeti `eziez dciaex, di` zexd yarl td, enwex d`eziez de` ngknd ril`d kpfkx lril.
`j ldnyij eldexic d`xd egiez nagipz dal drlieo d' zz`d lrelm dfd dytl, yde` vnvem bcel aizx rf, l` ci a`zrxez` clzz` yl zlnici gknim dreqwim nireh inidm avcwd ebnilez gqcim, `l` rl ici `zrxez` carli nvez dreqwim xea inidm avcwd ebnilez gqcim (ekne ypza`x alwehi `nxim aglw `' txw l"c). elko pwx`e "znki `exiiz`", edo agipez encxbez pvg edec, ldiezo nnyikio `ex dzexd lnhd lrelm dryid.

erl cxj nyl, ldacil daclez `io wu, kne y`cm `ipe ncax `l` l`gxim (el` kyde` aipe laio rvne), e`f nvnvm ykle engyaze acaexe `lidm. ednykilim iaipe:
fexr vcwd ykx `nz (anyli i"`). tixey, yykx fxirz dvcwd di` ncz `nz.

evxij ldaio, eki `io `nz airwa gq eylem rc ydwcey axej de` izo le nlnrld?
`j dpd necrz f`z, cncz irwa di` ncz xgnpez, eraecz d' ancz xgnpez di` da`d ndzrexxez xgnim xaim ala d`cm rl piveu `lwez yaptye, dxgewd n`ex tpi d' k`yx delj agyj dali relm, edzrexxez xgnpez fe di` a`d ndzaepd edcrz abcelz d', `ij y`tile drelnez drliepim lnrld nrld rc `io wu kl` nny gyiai wnid, ki kl ytrm egiezm `ipe xw nfie ed`xd n`ez `gc nyne izaxj, kn`nx: "aie"c pax` relm da` ke'".
edpd, afie ed`xd fe, yde` dztyhez dgiez nyne izaxj ldgiez rliepim ezgzepim, de` yiy dacl edtxy aio rliepim lzgzepim, y"relm dfd pax` ad' eke'", eko kl yipeii dtxhim yakl relm erelm de` lti yipeii vixeti d`eziez, eko yipeii dfnpim arax ded erzic, eyipeii kl dwexez agileti dfnpim dkl nyipeii vixeti d`eziez, ydo do dnykz dgiez nncezie izaxj yne (kne ypza`x alwehi `nxim glw a' txw i"`).
`al lbai ndeze ervneze izaxj kzia: "`pi d' l` ypizi", aio aagipz yipeii ddyzlylez nxem dnrlez rc lnhd nhd, ykne yde` izaxj nvei arliepim kj de` nny ayed azgzepim (ekne ypza`x alwehi `nxim glw `' txw p"`), eaio aagipz yipeii dfno, ykne ydid de` lace de`, igic eniegc, ltpi yyz ini ax`yiz kj de` rzd `gx daxi`d, ediipe, nyem ydkl k`io e`tq nny lbai ndeze ervneze, ekne `ez `gc ncaexe yl `cm `e `tile nngyaze lbai kllez ndez dpty dykliz ervnezd, rl cxj nyl, lykj `z d`fo, ea`nz "`io rxej `lij" kzia, ekne ypza`x anwem `gx (alwehi `nxim glw a' txw h') riio ym.
efde y`enxim: "dnlj dnxenm lace n`f", tixey, kne y"n`f" wecm daxi`d did de` lace de`, kj rzd de` "nxenm ke'" e"nzpy` ninez relm", tixey, yde` xm epy` lnrld nrld nagipz fno dpwx` aym "inez relm", ediipe lti ygiez kl "inez relm" de` xw nagipz "dnlj ke'", ekne ynae`x anwem `gx.
e`i lf`z, dxgnpez bceld n`c n`c rl dpiveu dyeko abes dgyej ed`tl, nyk` cgei`, drlel lwal hen`d eldzb`l akl dz`eez xgnp` lvlo, leli ydwcey axej de` nbo le epezo le ref ezrvenez llgem rm dbes ez`ezie elpvgo, efde y`enxim: "`ceo refpe ke' nbo iyrpe ke'".
edpd necrz f`z, ciy a' nipi cgile exgine: dx`yepez, do dpelcez ndzaepd edcrz abcelz d' eacaxim dnai`io lici `daz d' eix`ze, ed`gxepez, do da`ez `gx kj nlnrld aagipz nzpd, ekne ypza`x anwem `gx rl tqew: "raecz nzpd `zo `z kdepzkm", ydi` ncz `dad, eko de` bm ko aix`d.
edpd, ec`i `io rxej kll aio dx`yepez ydo zelcez dykl dpax`, lbai d`gxepez ydo ndaex` izaxj yne, elko do do dpwx`ez aym "`nz", ki "gezne yl dwcey axej de` `nz", yde` `nz d`nizi, ekl d`nz yapax`im kl` gyiai wnid.
`j `ifd dcxj yifkd d`cm l"`nz d'", dpd, de` rl ici yirexx xgnim xaim ltpi d' rl dpiveu yaptye, ydi` ncze yl irwa, "naxig ndwvd `l dwvd", cdiipe nxem dnrlez rc lnhd nhd, ldnyij "`nz d'" lrelm dytl dfd dgyej, ekne ykzea: "ki `ya agyj d' `ex li". efde "ki bax rlipe gqce ke'".
`j dzrexxez xgnim xaim ltpi d' vxij ldiez bm ko a`nz, ebm kyde` a`nz yle `ij iekl rl ici `nz yle lrexx xgnim rliepim n"`nz d'"?
`j drvd lfd di` ncz dvcwd, ydi` ncz dxgnim rl n`o cliz lid nbxnid ldgiez xeg ytlim ke', ea`zrxez` clzz` `zrxez` clril`, d' nrexx iypim enwiu pxcnim, dm agipz xgnim xaim egqcim rliepim dprlnim, lv`z nddrlm `l dbilei ed`xd xad, "l`ex a`ex dgiim", "`nz d' lrelm".
(efd) efde lyeo fxird dp`nx avcwd, ldvnig `nz drlieo, "`nz d'". eatxh, avcwd egqc yl `nz yreyim rm `xu dwcy zapd ezkepo andxd ainipe `no, lwiim nd ykzea: "`nz n`xu zvng", rl ici fxirz dvcwd ad, egqc exgnim xaim dp`qtim eplwhim lzekd, dm nrexxim bm ko gqcim rliepim dvtepim eprlnim (apeqg `gx: ad), kne ykzea: "`yx vtpz ke'" lkeppd eldwind. efde ykzea: "avcwd zkeppi":
`yxipe nd hea glwpe end prim bexlpe ke', "d' npz glwi ekeqi ebe'", "galim ptle li ebe'".
ldaio lyeo "glwpe" e"bexlpe" vxij la`x diha lyeo dybex an`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io le glw a`ldi iyx`l", ki dbm clk`exd l` yiij lyeo "glw" kll a`lwez izaxj, y`ipe nzglw lglwim gq eylem.
`j drpio, kne ykzea airwa: "eiwx` le `l `ldi iyx`l", tixey, ki dpd a`nz dwcey axej de` kyne ko de`, ki `s c`ide nnl` kl rlnio rliepim ezgzepim nxem dnrlez rc nzgz l`xu dlfe dgenxiz, kne ykzea: "dl` `z dynim e`z d`xu `pi nl`" "`pi" nny, cdiipe ndeze ervneze kaikel el` kaece lac, `s rl ti ko de` wcey eneacl nrliepim ezgzepim, e`ipe pztq kll azekm gq eylem kztiqz pynz d`cm abete rl cxj nyl, kne ynae`x anwem `gx a`xikez.
elf`z, l` die ikelim lwal giezm nndeze ervneze lace kaikel, xw dztyhez dgiez `yx dwcey axej de` ngid rliepim ezgzepim, de` rl cxj nyl, kne d`xd n`ixd nyne izaxj, yde` eyne `gc, ekne ykzea: "ki pyba yne lace", xw fiee e"dece rl `xu eynim ebe'".
ed`xd fe nzlayz nny arliepim ezgzepim ldgiezm, epztqz azekm rl ici nnevrim xaim, evnvenim xaim ervenim, adyzlylez dncxbez cxj rld erlel eke'.
edpd, d`xd fe, `s ylnrld di` n`ixd enztyhz aagipz ali bael ezkliz, ldgiez relnez prlnim l`io wu ezkliz, kne ykzea a`cx` xa`, `s rl ti ko, axczd lnhd rl ici vnvenim xaim ldgiez dpax`im edivexim edpryim, di` pglwz cxj kll lnqtx zxi"b, kpbc zxi"b nvez dzexd, ydo do zxi"b nipi dnykez d`xd fe n`ex `io qes axej de`, ld`ix lpynz d`cm dkleld nxn"g `axim eyq"d bicim, `yx araexd de` riwx zkliz ixicz ednykz d`xd fe lnhd lkl dpax`im edivexim edpryim, yzkliz kelo de` d`cm, kpecr:
edpd, nqtx fd de` acxj kll, `al acxj txh, dpd kl nved enved nzglwz ltxhim xaim l`io wu ezkliz, edo do beti dlkez txhiez yakl nved y`io ldm nqtx, kne ykzea: "yyim dnd nlkez" do q' nqkzez ke', "erlnez `io nqtx" do ddlkez ke', ydo dnykz xveo drlieo ke'.
eko de` nny apynz d`cm, ki dpd, kl dpynez yarelm die klelez a`cm dx`yeo, ecxj kll, dizd pynze pglwz lnqtx zxi"b: xn"g `axim eyq"d bicim, `j cxj txh, pglwz lpivevez `io nqtx, ydo pynez kl iyx`l ninez d`aez edyahim rc ai`z dnyig erc akll, yiweim `f nd ykzea: "edid nqtx api iyx`l kgel dim, `yx l` inc el` iqtx" nxea.
edpd, "yetxid cirwa nrio yetxid c`cm dx`yeo", yziwo gh` `cm dx`yeo, edizd pynze bm ko kleld nkl dpynez yaiyx`l, nrelm erc relm, edid nxkad lzexd ylnrld, ypwx`z aym "`cm", kne ykzea: "erl cnez dkq` cnez knx`d `cm eke'", ekne ykzea: "ef`z ltpim aiyx`l ke'" "`io f`z `l` zexd ke'", ydizd kleld enleayz apynz "iyx`l qa`", dkleld nkl dpynez.
efde "eiwx` le `l `ldi iyx`l" "`l" lyeo dnykz dd`xd n`ex `io qes axej de` nddrlm `l dbilei, ld`ix aagipz bilei apynze, ekne ykzea: "`l d' ei`x lpe"; e`gxie kl iyxi la, dreqwim azexd eanvez, n`ix `ex d' `io qes axej de` aagipz bilei apynzm.
efno bilei fd aizx y`z eizx rf dd`xd anegm elam de` ayrz dztld, kne ynae`x anwem `gx.
edpd, `s ybilei fd rl ici rqw dzexd ednvez de` yed lkl pty niyx`l acxj kll, ki zexd `gz enyth `gc lkelpe, `s rl ti ko, acxj txh, `io kl dptyez `e dxegez edpynez yeez arpio fd lti rz efno blbelm eae`m arelm dfd ekn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`aej an`i dei fdix hti, `nx lid aviviz ke'".
eko, `io kl dcexez yeio. ki kne y`axi d`cm, kl `ax iy le treld txhiz eniegcz, drio lx`ez ed`fo lyner, kj akl nved n`ix `ex txhi eniegc n`ex `io qes axej de`.
e`s ykl pty niyx`l vxikd lae` ablbel lwiim kl zxi"b nvez, nkl nwem l` pvxkd `l` ldrctd efdixez efxifez izixd, aizx y`z eizx rf, kteld enketlz, lnrld nrld nfdixez y`x dnvez. efde y`nx "an`i dei fdix hti" "hti" ciiw`.
edpd, izxeo d`ex dfd dtxhi lpynez txhiez `ipe aagipz hrm ecrz neyb, `l` lnrld nagipz dcrz, ykj rld angyad ltpie izaxj, ecebnze lnhd de` agipz dbexl nny:
fexr vcwez, nvnig iyerez. dpd, nd ykzea lyeo "fxird" anvez dvcwd, ekne ykzea atqew: "fxre lkm lvcwd ke'", ieao rl ti nd y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "xai `lrfx idia txehd lrpi edcx nvli, ckzia: `pi avcw `gfd tpij". tixey, ki bilei `lweze izaxj dnzbld angyaze yl `cm ekepze aztlze, kl gc ltem yirex` cilid, de` azexz vcwd "egqc d' nrelm erc relm rl ix`ie ke'".
klenx, y`ex d' `io qes axej de` dn`ix lnrld arelnez rliepim, ad`xd xad aagipz bilei xa ervem, rc ya`nz do ahlio anvi`ez ekl` nny gyiai wnid epkllio a`exe izaxj, edo do ddiklez rm dnl`kim edpynez yado, dnae`xim afedx dwcey aynezm lnwenezm aqcx dztld yqcxe lpe `pyi kpqz dbceld, dpd, nym n`ix d`ex ki hea lrelm dytl dfd, rl "ix`i d' egeyai yne", dgtvim lrace a"raecd yala fe ztld", ekne ykzea: "ed' ibid gyki".
edpd, ixicz d`xd fe lnhd lrelm dfd, pwx`z aym "gqc d'", dnkepd aym "nim", diexcim nnwem baed lnwem pnej ke':
edpd, necrz f`z, yiy lnrld bm ko ncz dbaexd edvnvem, lvnvm eldqzix `exe izaxj lal izbld lzgzepim. `j dkl zlei a"`zrxez` clzz`", y`m d`cm nzpdb agqicez ldytir giim egqc ke' kj nrexx lnrld, kne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "ancd y`cm necc ad neccio le".
`l` clk`exd fe `ipd no dncd, ki `m ldytir le gii drelm da` lac kpbc nd yde` nytir gii relm dfd, `al l` ldytir le gii d`xz `ex d' peqg `gx: `io qes axej de` nny, yi`ix eibid gyke a"raecd yala fe ztld", ydi` agipz encxbz zyead ril`d kpecr ydxi di` lnrld nrld nkl gii relm da`, kne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "itd yrd `gz azyead enryim heaim ke'", ekne ypza`x anwem `gx a`xikez, crelm da` `ipe `l` fie ed`xd eke':
`j drpio de`, rl cxj nyl, kne yfexrio fxrim `e pehrio bxrio, ydyaelz dvengz ndfxr, ed`ilo etixezie ndbxrio, `ipo ndezo ervnezo yl dfxr edbxrio kll, ki ndezm ervnezm kld epxwa a`xu, ekg dveng ya`xu rvnd peqg `gx: rvne de` dnevi` ednbcl dyaelz ed`ilo etixezie. xw y`ipe nevi` enbld kge lgeu ndkg `l dterl, ki `m rl ici dfxr edbxrio ypxwaio a`xu ekld kl kgm akg dveng ya`xu, epz`gce edie l`gcim, erl ici fd nevi` kg dveng `z kge `l dterl, enytir giez lbcl yaelz krio dfxr, `al axiaei dxad n`c ayaelz `gz, eko tixez dxad rl `ilo `gc, ebm ndezo ervnezo yl dtixez nreld arilei xa ervem lnrld nrld nndeze ervneze yl dbxrio dpher. eko kd`i bep` atixez d`xu dbclim nfxrepio krio bxripio, kne wye`im ekd`i bep`.
edkl de`, ntpi yriwx eyxy giez dtixez pytr nkg dveng ya`xu, dkell giez kl dtixez. edbxripio dfxerim a`xu, `ipo `l` krio "`zrxez` clzz`", dpwx`z aym "drl`z niio pewaio" akzai d`xif"l:
ekkd nny rl cxj nyl, kl nryd dvcwd yreyio iyx`l, reld lnrld aagipz "drl`z niio pewaio" lyexy pynezido lnrld, dpwx` aym "kpqz iyx`l" e"`in` zz`d" alyeo dfdx, e"ykipd" alyeo dbnx`, dkleld nkl ncezie yl dwcey axej de`, eniegcz ado azkliz, ex`yizo di` ncz dgqc. erl ici drl`d fe nzrexx "gqc d'" nny, yde` bilei `exe izaxj, lixc eld`ix lnhd lpynez iyx`l, aagipz bilei xa ervem ayrz dztld rl kl tpim. ki `s y"lbcelze `io gwx", rc c"kel` wnid kl` gyiai" dxi "anwem y`zd nev` bcelze, ym `zd nev` rpezpeze", k"nim yiexcio ke'".
efde ykzea: "fxg agyj `ex liyxim, gpeo exgem evciw", crl ici yd`cm "gpeo exgem evciw" "vcwez `da", bexm l`ex d' yifxg lpynze dnleayz abete, drenc agyj, yde` nyk` cgei`. efd pwx` aym "iyerd", kc `zdtk` gyek` lpdex`.
efde "nvnig iyerez", yiyerd fe vengz nfxirz dvcwd yfexrio a`xu drliepd, "`xu gtu", di` dykipd ekpqz iyx`l, ypwx`z ko rl ym ynzlayz azgzepim ldgiezm, kne ykzea: "nlkezj nlkez kl relnim".
eatxh no dtxh, kyfexrio a`xu dwcy dzgzepd dnkeepz kpbcd nny, ydfxird pwlhz ziks enic a`xu drliepd, ali yem npird erikea arelm, n`gx y`io yem cax gevu entqiw kll aio "`xvez dgiim", ki "fd yrx dynim" nd y`io ko ageu l`xu, eci lnaio:
`deaii `gii exrii `yx kptyi, a`zi knfkix enrexx iypim azxcnz dali dalim, eltweg ripi drexim iaihe lx`ez, ldiez kl iyrm egtvm enbnzm lkl adm gii xegm a"nwex nim giim" gii dgiim, kl ini giidm, npty erc ayx. cdiipe, kl nili crln` erqwi txpqd l` idid k`le cracio lbxniide, el` idid aiz iyx`l kkl dbeim, cfpio entxpqio enewxio lpyiide eapiide n`dad, ki "ni krnj iyx`l bei `gc a`xu" kzia, cdiipe ybm arpipi `xu l` itxice peqg `gx: itxce n`gc d`nz gq eylem, ldric rcez ywx gq eylem, awxi`z ynr rxa eaewx, aripim qbexez, "d' `gc" ac' xegez eaynim nnrl ea`xu nzgz, eatweg ripi drexim "dzris ripij ae e`ippe" gq eylem.
`j af`z i`ez lpe, ldiez peqg `gx: adiez kl rqwipe anili crln` l` lbxniide, ki `m, ldgiez ptyez glwi `lwez, elnl`ez ngqexidm agqc gpm, yafd `pe ncnio dvexd lievxd, d' `gc, `yx "gqc `l kl diem", gqc yl `nz, ldgiez drelm enle`e akl xbr exbr, xw y`yze eapie yl `cm wecnio lkl rl ti dzexd geu nvciwim yacex ydo wecnio lapie, evciwim ya`xu iyx`l wecnio lvciwim yageu l`xu, lac nf`z yl` dpige knezo ageu l`xu, eci lnaio.
rl ko, `deaii `gii, yine p` laakm l`ld dcaxim dp`nxim awvxd n`c (e`m ixvd d' td `l td `cax am a`xekd), `ij diez kl riwx raecz d' arzim dlle arwaez nyig` di` raecz dvcwd, kne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io iyx`l pb`lio `l` avcwd". el` `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd "zlnec zexd ywel kpbc bnilez gqcim", `l` ainidm, yzlnec zexd did riwx draecd `vlm, erl ko die gknim bcelim zp`im e`nex`im. nd y`io ko arwaez nyig`, yptld "qekz cec" rc agipz xblim erwaiim, ydi` agipz ryid, `io cxj lcawd ad a`nz eldtk` gyek` lpdex` cild peqg `gx: cilid ki `m aagipz ryid bm ko, ydi` nryd dvcwd, kicer lnykilim, yagipz ryid a`lwez di` agipz dytrz ednykz dgiez lnhd nhd ln`o cliz lid nbxnid klem. ekl dfeag `z ivxe afd etezg ice elaae, `zkti` qhx` `gx` endtj gyek` l`ex dym izaxj, dyeko rlipe aagipz ryid arwaez nyig`, eifkd lx`ez "rio ario ayea d' vieo" ke':
`gx cxiyz ylenm egiim, tzg caxi irix `fo yenrz zekgz giim, `yx dekig d' giim rl ici pai`e, e`nx: gqci d' ki l` znpe ebe', eded lid lninx "ki l` zne", kne y`enxim: "ki l` zne gqcij ebe'". eieao rl ti nd ykzea afedx dwcey: "`iz gqc e`iz gqc, `iz gqc relm ke' e`iz gqc ril`d cde` xa gqc ke'".
ki dpd necrz f`z, dzexd pwx`z "ref", yde` lyeo baexd, ekne y`nxe gknipe fkxepm laxkd: "zxi"b nvez p`nxe lnyd nqipi nti dbaexd"; ekckzia: "ninipe `y cz lne", tixey, ydzexd nwexd eyxyd de` xw gqci d', dnkepim aym "inio", cdiipe, dnykz agipz `ldeze izaxj ed`xd n`ex `io qes axej de` `l drelnez rliepim ezgzepim, rl ici d`cm dnnyij d`ex rl rvne, awiem xn"g nvez ryd, ydo xn"g `axim cnlk`, tixey xn"g klim elaeyim ld`xd px`d cvxij ldiez: ldd`xd n`ex `io qes axej de` dnleay ado (en`ex fd ienyj le cgile exgine akl nved kpecr).
xw ydnykd fe pzlayd zgld ancz baexze yl dwcey axej de`, dnkepd aym "`y", ydi` agipz vnvem d`ex edgiez dpnykez n`ex `io qes axej de`, kci yzekl ldzlay anryd dnvez, yxeao kkelo dm acaxim genxiim, kviviz eztilio ewxapez evcwd.
e`s nvez ydo axegpiez d`cm, kne ix`d e`dad, `s rl ti ko, do aagipz bael encd el` aagipz `io qes kll, ki `dad xad ld' ali wu ebael encd `io d`cm ikel lqeald alae eldiez wiim abete `tile xbr, ekn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, yayrz nzo zexd, ydizd dzblez `ldeze izaxj e`ex `io qes axej de` aagipz ciaex edzblez "txgd pynzo ke'";
edpd, lti ydnvez pizpe lpe rl ici dzlayez ancz baexd evnvem dd`xd ke', lko xea dnvez iy ldo yirex nvenvm, kne: `exj dviviz i"a beclio, edztilio `varim rl `varim enxearez cew`, edlela c' htgim, edqekd f' htgim, edyetx htg, ednwed n' q`d, eko awxapez iy ldo yirex nvenvm lfno, kne kayim api ypd, e`ilim api yzim, etxim ke'.
eko anryd dvcwd ebnilez gqcim annepe, `s ydi` ndrnecim ydrelm renc rlidm, ekckzia: "relm gqc iapd", `tile dki iy ld yirex wvea, geny lnved no dneagx, enryx lncd aipepiz ke' efd pwx` "gqc relm", tixey: "gqc `l kl diem", dnzlay arelnez rliepim ezgzepim, rl ici `zrxez` clzz`, di` nvez dvcwd egqc yreyim api `cm fd rm fd.
elti ydrelm de` aagipz bael encd "nd`xu rc lxwir z"w ypd, eko nxwir lxwir ke'", e"yiz `lti ypi dei rln`" ke', lko pizo yirex encd bm ko lnvez dvcwd edgqc yazexd kne ly`x nvez dzexd.
`j, diipe cew` lyenx dzexd el` qx nnpd inio eyn`l `tile knl` pin`; `al ni ydraix rlie dcxj gq eylem, n`gx ydred cxke, lzz nbxrez awcy drlieo, ybxr rxke, agipz dnykze, nd ydid ikel ldnyij nagipz `ldeze ed`xz d`ex n`ex `io qes axej de` `ile did yenx dzexd enwiind kdlkzd dxi nreez fd l` iekl lzwo, ki `m adnykz d`ex drlieo ylnrld ndrelnez e`ipe nzlay ado, dpwx` "gqc ril`d" e"xa gqc", lti yn`ix enztyh aagipz `io qes ali bael encd, n`gx y`ippe nvenvm zej drelnez `l` aagipz nwis rlido nlnrld, nxiy kl cxbio rc qes eke', ekyd`cm nnyike lnhd anryie e"`zrxez` clzz`", `fi, `ex rlieo fd n`ix enztyh zej drelnez enzwo kl nreez ekl nbxrez ypizpe awcy drlieo, engcy `exo eheao aizx y`z eizx rf, aagipz `ex gcy nny. lko `nxe: "anwem yarli zyead rencio eke'".
edpd, riwx dzyead de` ala, ki rl ici dgxhd nrenw` cla` nrexx renw `ex drlieo dfd.
`j kci ldnyike ld`ix arelnez rliepim ezgzepim vxij "`zrxez` clzz`" nny aagipz nryd, cdiipe, nryd dvcwd egqc ali bael encd, ckne yd`cm nytir xa gqc, tixey g"q cli"z, cdiipe lcl e`aieo "cliz lid nbxnid klem", e`ipe pezo bael encd lpzipze edytrze, kj dwcey axej de` nytir `exe eheae aagipz gqc ril`d, dpwx` "xa gqc", dn`ix aagipz `io qes ali bael encd zej drelnez rliepim ezgzepim, ykelm dm aagipz cli"z `vle izaxj, cliz ldeo nbxnideo klem, e"kel` wnid kl` gyiai", erl ici fd pzwpe kl dtbnim ytbm d`cm arepezie lnrld arelnez rliepim ezgzepim.
efde ykzea: "ryd vcwd enyth pagx ld' nfag", lti ydwxapez do aagipz yirex encd ebael, nd y`io ko avcwd yiekl ltfx ali bael lzwo repezie.
end y`nxe: "dnafaf `l iafaf iezx ngeny", diipe cew` ani yl` gh`, `e yzwo gh`ie aqibetim ezrpiez kx`ei, lzwo kl dtbnim lnrld. `al ni yvxij lzwo ptye rciio, tyih` cl` bxrd xte`z dpty nxte`z dbes, y`io kqs pgya "ekl `yx l`iy izo arc ptye" kzia.
edpd, ncz gqc fe ali bael encd pwx`z rl yne yl dwcey axej de` "gqci d'", kckzia: "egqc d' nrelm erc relm ke'". ki dbm ykl iyx`l dm xgnpim ebenli gqcim, axm iy bael encd lxgni d`cm, `al dwcey axej de` pwx` "`io qes axej de`", elncezie `io qes, kckzia: "ki l` kle xgnie eke'".
efde y`nx dpai` `gx dgexao edblez: "gqci d' ki l` znpe ebe'", tixey: lti y"l` znpe", y`io `pe zninim eylnim ali yem gh` etbm apty earelnez rliepim, rl ko vxikio `pe ldzpdb agqci d' ydm ali bael ezkliz, kci lrexx rlipe xgnim egqc ril`d, yde` xa gqc exgnim ali bael ezkliz, kne ykzea: "ki l` kle xgnie ebe'".
efde y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io iyx`l pb`lio `l` avcwd", yirye bm `m idie thexim ncip`, ki "`io ao cec a` ke'":
ldykilj aipd, ki l` fe dcxj iykeo `ex d' ldiez gtu agii ayxim eapi enfepi, ki rl fd `nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd "ahl xvepj ke'", cdiipe, yidid xvepe ahl anvi`ez, el` idid le yem xveo kll arpipi relm dfd kelm, dpkllim aapi gii enfepi, ekn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd y"rl kxgj `zd gi";
eai`ex drpio, de` xw `nepd `niziz a"ievx ax`yiz", cdiipe, ydaxi`d "iy" n"`io", dpwx`z "x`yiz gknd" edi` gknze y`ipd neybz lyem pax` daxi`d df`z, di` akl rz exbr, ynzdeim kl daxe`im "iy" n"`io" ngknze izaxj dngid `z dkl, ekyizaepo d`cm arenw dapze, eiviix acrze deeiize n"`io" akl xbr exbr nny, d`ij irld rl crze ki xr le, `e yem iqexim napi gii enfepi, `e y`xi iqexio arelm, dxi d"`io", ydi` gknze izaxj, de` nwex dgiim edhea edrepb, ede` drco ylnrld nrelm da`, xw, ntpi y`ipe neyb, lko pcnd le xr `e iqexim, `al a`nz `io xr iexc nlnrld, edkl hea, xw y`ipe neyb lbecle exa heae.
efde riwx d`nepd yayaild pax` d`cm, ld`nio c"liz `zx tpei nipid", e"a`ex tpi nlj giim", erl ko "ref egced anwene" de`il ede` xw hea kl diem.
erl ko, x`yiz dkl, yiyng d`cm eibl akl rz eyrd, eigid nny a`nepze ad', dngid enhia rne akl xbr. eni ynzrva enz`epo nx`d arvne yiy le nrh xr eiqexio egqx le `ifd head, edxi fd kketx gq eylem. erl ko dxgiwe ncz drvaez an`c gkni d`nz.
`al dn`nio l` igey nyem iqexio arelm, eakl rpipi drelm "do" e"l`e" yeio `vle adyee`d `niziz.
eni y`io yeio le, nx`d arvne yde` n"rxa xa" c"lbxniide racio", e`eda `z rvne, lv`z nzgz ic d' elgiez agii dbeim ayail `daze `z rvne, erl ko de` gtu agii ayxim eapi enfepi, ki fd hea le.

ea`nepd fe a`nz, pryd dkl hea bm ablei, ya`nepd fe yn`nio ydxr dpcnd ablei, kl gieze de` n"hea" drlieo, ydi` gknze izaxj y`ipd neybz, edi` d"rco" ylnrld nrelm da`, dxi a`nepd fe pkll enzrld a`nz dxr dncend a"hea" drlieo dbpef:

`j dwcey axej de` reyd ylem aipidm, cdiipe, rl ici bilei ynzbld ado d`xd xad edytrd rvend n`c n`ex `io qes axej de`, `yx kyne ko de`, y`ipe aagipz ncd gq eylem, `l` lnrld nrld rc `io wu, `tile nagipz gknd aipd crz nwex dncez, e`fi, dncez pbciez yl nik`l ebaxi`l pkllez anwexo eyxyo, edie l`gcim nny, eahlim a`exe izaxj dn`ix ldm aagipz bilei.

edpd, `zrxez` clril`, lrexx bilei d`xd xad edytrd rvend dpfkxz lril, n`ex `io qes axej de`, lryez ylem dpfkx lril, di` a`zrxez` clzz`, anryd dvcwd edytrz giim go egqc exgnim ln`o cliz lid nbxnid klem, eldgiez xeg ytlim ke'.

eaixex fd idid bm ko rl ici bilei `lweze lnhd ad`xd xad edytrd rvend, kne ykzea: "ki nl`d d`xu crd `z d'", "epbld kaec d' ke'".
efde akllez drelm lrzic, `j a`cm dzgzeo, akl "rz nve`" fe ztld, `e y`x rzim nfenpim ldzaecc rm wepe, kl `gc lti nryie, fekd lnrio aixex fd, rl ici rqw dzexd lynd eko rl ici dvcwd, kne y`nxe: "xai `lrfx idia txehd lrpi edcx nvli, ckzia: `pi avcw `gfd tpij", di` agipz bilei d`xd edytrz dcrz edzaepd, ldzaepo abcelz d', eldelic nfd cgile exgine ykliim kpecr.

edpd necrz f`z, yiyx`l aharm dm xgnpim ebenli gqcim, ntpi diez ptyezidm pnykez nncezie izaxj, `yx dgqc beax ado rl ncz dcio edbaexd edvnvem, ekne ykzea: "bax gqce rl ixi`ie", ylko pwx`z dpynd "az kdo" kne ykzea afedx dwcey.
edpd, dvcwd dpnykz nagipd fe, pwx`z aym "nryd dvcwd", ki ym "nryd" petl rl cax ykax pryd, `e ypryd znic nnil` edi` cax ddeed exbil znic. e`s k`o, dxi ncz dgqc edxgnpez dehard aptyez kl aiz iyx`l nkax nrz axi`ezo edyzlylezo nncezie izaxj, kne ykzea: "eitg a`tie ke'", "e`zd ptgz ai", "en`o cptg ke'", ebm akl iem eiem aheae ngcy nryd ax`yiz, e"gcyim lawxim ke'".
`j lyeo "raecd" `ipe petl `l` rl cax yd`cm reyd aibird rvend pbc har ptye, xw ynahl hare exvepe ntpi xveo drlieo axej de`, kbeo liibr rvne azexd eaztld "rc nivei dpty ke'". e`s k`o anvez dvcwd, lizo dxad iezx nhar xgnpeze exvepe ekne y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd rl tqew "pzo zzo" "`tile n`d trnim eke'".
efde ykzea "edid nryd dvcwd", ybm dvcwd dpwx`z aym "nryd" el` aym "raecd", `s rl ti ko, a"`zrxez` clzz` `zrxez` clril`", nrexx bilei `ex `io qes axej de` ad`xd xad edytrd rvend, epryd ylem anxenie ebm atnli` yl nhd.
xw yarelm dfd dytl l` izbld dylem edaixex etixec dxr ndhea rc rz wu el` afno dblez, kpfkx lril. xw a"relm who" de` d`cm akl "rz nve`" fe ztld, kne ykzea "avcw `gfd tpij", kpfkx lril. `j `gx dztld, iekl ldiez dxr gefx epirex awl eldzrxa ahea, k`yx izdlj agykz relm dfd.
`j dvcwd aagipz "raecd", dpd, n`yx iwxd ebcld nrlzd an`c n`c, adieze nahl hare exvepe dbetpi ntpi xveo drlieo axej de`, e`zkti` qhx` `gx`, e`fi `qzlw iwx` cwecy` axij de` ke', e"kizxeo d`ex no dgyj" cew` kpecr, `i lf`z `io dxr ikel ldiez rec gefx epirex awlez kl kj n`lie, xw `m d`cm irexxpe einyikpe rl rvne gq eylem.
efde ykzea "dywh eahg rc relm", "dywh" de` nlyeo "yewh rl ynxie", cdiipe, ydynxim ptxcim lbnxi no diio epetlio lnhd lbnxi, ediio lnrld fj evlel azkliz. erl cxj fd de` a"raecz dvcwd", d"ynxim" do agipz zrxeaz xr yaptye, paxx eptxc nrh nrh rc ypetl lnhd lnwexe eyxye, ekne ykzea: "ezylij anvelez im kl gh`zm":
nd xa heaj `yx vtpz lix`ij ebe'.
dpd, akll reaci d' iy a' agipez encxbez glewez nvc yexy pynzm lnrld, nagipz inio eyn`l.

edpd, nncd fe pnykd bm ko agipz dvnvem edbael araecz d', kne avcwd ldiez piceo adyb ic, e"dnafaf `l iafaf iezx ngeny", ekd`i bep` azlnec zexd ey`xi nvez, ci le yiev` ici geaze ngiea ntexy ygiiaze dzexd atixey lwaer rzim ke'. ennpd pnyj bm ko nd y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "fxew nxd azlnicim ke'".
`j agipz inio, di` ncz dgqc eddztyhez araecz d', adzxgaez ali vnvem edqzx kll, kne ykzea: "e`zdlkd axgad ke'", ebm ali vnvem ebael kll, e`io nrvex lxeg pcaze, aio avcwd eaio azlnec zexd ey`xi nvez, el` ci le lv`z ici geaze alac, `l` rc ali ci ke':
edpd, kl `iy iyx`l vxij ldiez klel na' agipez `le, e"`io lj cax y`io le nwem".
elko nvipe knd caxim nweli aiz yn`i engenxi aiz dll, llncpe, y`s aiz yn`i yyxy pynzm nagipz yn`l drlieo, elko die cpio ldgnix znic akl `iqexi dzexd, eaiz dll ydie nagipz inio drlieo, die nlncio fkez ldwl eldzix `iqexi aiz yn`i, yidie nezxim n`iqexm eiekle lrlez lnrld, `s rl ti ko, aknd caxim die aiz yn`i nwilio, ntpi dzkllez yxy pynzm yde` klel bm ninio.

end y`nx dkzea: "`axdm `edai" e"tgc ivgw", dpd ddtxy eddacl dfd de` aagipz bilei edrlm, yancz ivgw dtgc de` aagipz bilei ed`dad nqezxz aagipz drlm edqzx, edditj ancz `axdm `aipe rlie dylem.

e`nx rl ko, `yx "xa hea laiz iyx`l", dvteo edblei, de` aagipz ali bael encd lti rxj ptyezm dnleayz abes, lko, bm `zd d' zzpdb rndm ancz gqcj dbcel ali bael ezkliz, dpwx` "xa gqc".
c"`iz gqc e`iz gqc": `iz gqc relm, yiy kpbce elrenze ncz dcio gq eylem, lnrh elvnvm gqce eheae. `al gqc rlieo dpwx` "xa gqc", `io kpbce ncz dcio lnrh elvnvm xea gqce nldztyh ali bael ezkliz, ki de` pnyj nagipz "qeaa kl rlnio" e"hnix` ckl hnixio", dpwx` "kzx rlieo". efde ykzea: "zqzixm aqzx tpij ebe' zvtpm aqekd ebe'":
lrexx `z d`dad diypd egaz `xu dwecy, ldiez aerxz kxyti `y nwxa `iy ela rnew, k`le diem nny pzo d' xege rlipe, xeg pciad, adzpca rm lnl`ez icm ld', aic nl`d exgad, axiaei `gx xiaei, nci ypd aypd, delj ereld lnrld x`y, kncz "wcy drlieo" dn`ix l`xu dwecy, dnzgcy enzxad znic, kckzia: "znic ripi d' `ldij ad, nxyiz dypd erc `gxiz ypd";

`j drpio ieao, rl ti nd ykzea: "d' agknd iqc `xu", yiqec d"`xu drliepd" di` agipz "nnl` kl rlnio", edzgzepd di` "`xu gtu" dnkeepz kpbcd nny epwx`z rl ynd "`xu dgiim", dpd de` pnyj ndnykz ed`xz gknd ril`d, nwex dgiim drliepim, kckzia: "dgknd zgid arlid eke'".
ed`xd ednykd fe di` nzgcyz a`ex gcy nny akl ypd eypd, ki de` izaxj egknze `gc azkliz digec, epwx` aym "`ex `io qes axej de`", y`io qes e`io wu lnrlz ebcelz d`ex edgiez dpnyj nnpe izaxj engknze, arilei `gx rilei, rc `io wu ezkliz, lxem dnrlez lnrld nrld.

eatxhi txhiez, ko de` akl iem eiem, pnykio negio rliepim iezx akl ztlz dygx, e`ipo negio dx`yepim ypqzlwe `gx dztld, xw baedio iezx.
ecxj kll akllez drelm a"yiz `lti ypio", ko de` akl x`y dypd ex`y dypd.

ed`xd ednykd fe, `s ydi` zniciz, `s rl ti ko `ipd aagipd encxbd `gz lacd nini relm, `l` yakl ypd eypd de` `ex gcy rlieo, ki d`ex ypzgcy ed`ix ax`y dypd fd, de` nqzlw arxa x`y dypd da`d lyxye. efde ykzea "nxyiz dypd erc `gxiz ypd" lacd.

`j bileie nddqzx dfd, zlei anryd dzgzepim efkezm ezyeazm aryxz ini zyead, eci lnaio:

`j vxij ldwcim, nd yynrzi nnexi rlie dylem rl tqew "e`pki rtx e`tx", y`nx `axdm `aipe rlie dylem rl d`xz pynze dn`ixd abete n`ex gqc rlieo, edi` ncze ncz "`dad xad", (peqg `gx: yad did) ydid `eda `z dwcey axej de` `dad bceld erliepd kl kj, rc ypryd "nxkad" ldwcey axej de`.
