efde "gyaeo bcel", yrl ici xea "nryd dvcwd ylem", ki tixey "ylem" de` cax dngax enzeej a' wveez dtkiim, ydo wvd dynim lril`, agipz "elbcelze `io gwx", ewvd dynim lzz`, dnzlay aaxi`d ivixd ryid, agipz bael enqtx, eci lnaio:

ekkd nny, rl cxj nyl, dpd kl pynez iyx`l pwx`im agipz "`axi cykipz`", dpwx`z aym "la", kne ykzea: "evex laai", ekne ykzea: "eykpzi azekm": tixey, ki lyeo ykipd" de`, y`ex dei' yeko arelnez axi`d ivixd ryid ldgiezm.
ednykz giez fd di` rl ici dzlayez zgld apynez iyx`l, lti ykl dpax`im, `io rxej ldm `l daex` izaxj, ckel` wnid kl` nny gyiaio, e`i `tyx ldm lwal giez n`exe eytre izaxj, ldiez pax`im n`io liy egiim ewiinim, ki `m rl ici dpynez yrle angyad, ewcne laxi`z relnez yrl ici agipz dcaex, kn`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "ani pnlj dwcey axej de` eke'", kpecr anwem `gx.

`yx rl ko, rl ti dcaxim ed`nz d`ld, `yx `i `tyx la`x diha ankza, pwx`z dykipd aym "la", edpynez aym "`axim": ldexez lpe, ki k`yx kl dpynez caewez enweyxez igc `fi qiaea edilej dgiez eddytrd qeaa qeaa, epreu qeto azglzo, lwyx elgax kelo ldei' `gc elcawd ae izaxj, ekne ykzea: "`zm pvaim diem kelkm ltpi dei' `lwikm" "kelkm" ciiw`, e"ltpi" ciiw`, "x`yikm ke' ngeha rvij ke'".
eafd ieao n`nx xaezipe fkxepm laxkd, ki gexao aiz ypi eptilz iyx`l ablez edqzlwez dykipd eixiczd l`cem aagipz blez, kaikel, dkl did areo yp`z gpm etixec laaez xgnp` lvlo. elko pwx`z "geld" rl cxj nyl, kne ykzea: "qenj petlim exet` gelim" lyeo xaim, dm kl d`axim eke':
axj d' gilm eterl icm ixvd, lxveo ldm ltpi d' znic, kd izo ekd ieqis d' l`nu lam abaexim, epcia rl pciaez iwem, ldiez bcel dnryd akl rix enpio, ezgya le lvcwd.
erl dreyd p`nx: "vcwze rencz lrc" "rencz" lyeo pwad, ynwal dzrexxez lae dhdex n"bcel dnryd", `s rl ti ko "rencz lrc".
tixey, ykl dvcwd edgqc yiyx`l reyio arelm dfd npcaz lam dhdex do dpd giez ewiinez arelm dfd dbyni rc fno dzgiid, y`f, de` fno bilei `lwez e`ex `io qes axej de` nagipz qeaa kl rlnio arelm dfd, ekne ypza`x a`xikez ankza c`yzwc.
evxij ldiez kli enkeo ldzlay ae `ex `io qes axej de`, kne dbes lpynd rl cxj nyl, kne ykzea: "dl` kd caxi k`y" "nd `y `ipd n`ixd arelm dfd `l` kyp`gfz enzlayz atzild ke'", kne ypza`x anwem `gx.
edbes edkli l`exe izaxj di` ncz dgqc epciaz dla, lizo eldytir giez ln`o cliz lid ke', kne ykzea aziwepim: "eknd betio zwipz leo, e`zwxi`e aziwep` c` gqc cxer` inip`", ekl dbes pkll ainio, ekj `nx dtiih: "laeye vcwd".
efde y`nxe xaezipe fkxepm laxkd: "`io dvcwd nyzlnz `l` lti gqc yad, yp`nx: "fxre lkm lvcwd, wvxe lti gqc": ydwvix de` bilei dfxird dhnepd a`xu, ekj de` dvcwd edgqc yiyx`l reyio afno dblez, di` hnepd epqzxz rc fno dzgid, yizlay ei`ix `ex `io qes axej de` arelm dfd dbyni, e"`ide ebxnedi gc", dm agipez dklim cryx qtixez c`vilez, ekl yko ewl egenx `ex `io qes axej de` dqeaa kl rlnio nlnrld nrld nagipz `vilez.
eltikj pwx`z "vcwd" lyeo pwad "vcwze rencz lrc", ynwalz d`xd n`ex `io qes dqeaa kl rlnio, dnzlay azekd arelm dfd dbyni afno dzgid.
`al "vcw ltpie idlj" de` lyeo fkx, di` ncz dgqc dnzrexxz ala d`cm nrvne, rl ici dzrexxez `daz d' awxi`z ynr, elcawd ae, elnqex ptye a"`gc", e"akl n`cj" ktyehe eke'.
ea"`zrxez` clzz`", e"knim dtpim ltpim ko la" `cm drlieo ke' "`zrxez` clril`", de` dnykz `ex `io qes axej de` dqeaa kl rlnio lnhd nhd arelm dfd dbyni aagipz bilei afno dzgid, knae`x ankza c`yzwc a`xikez.
efde "ltpie idlj", ynelij ennyij "tpim" drliepim nlnrld nd`vilez rc relm dryid. ekrz rz lwvx, ekl hea ndm l` iavx, "dhiad d' lheaim eliyxim alaezm", kpty zcxype:

`al ldrlez nnhd lnrld, de` cew` rl ici ngyad head, cal` cgile exgine l` txg` lril`, ekne ykzea ayrx dpae`d txw a', edngyad head ke'.
end ykzea c"awr xwirio eke'", ediipe, `tile al` cgile exgine, ankl yko ncaxim ahlim cncd head nxead, diipe "xwirio" cew`, ydo d"diklez" ed"azim", el` abes d"`cm drlieo", ekl yko apty xeg pynd `tile a"`cm cryid", ydo i' qtixez, `exez eklim. efde ykzea azwepim, "cal` cgile exgine l` ikl` lqlw` elniwm wcm d'" cew`:
riio ru giim yrx dpwecez yrx g' txw e', y`io dgfxz tpim atpim ki `m rl ici nvez nryiez cew`. ehrm dcax, ki rl ici nryim heaim bexm fieeb drlieo eke'.

edpd, dnryim heaim pwx`im "kqeg ewiveu dwevim", dp`gfim a`gexiim, ydo agipz ryid, kne ykzea ayrx n"f txw d', ediipe rl ici drl`z dhea dbpef adm dnleay anvez nryiez lnwexe, lwceyz d`vilez ykax deaxxd.

eafd ieao cdxdex l` raic nici, ki ali drl`z "niio pewaio" nd"nlkim" ya"pebd", `i `tyx ldnyij hitio nlnrld lfeeb frix `ptio epewa`, ki xevd lipw n`ne el` ldytir lnhd, kne ykzea ayrx n"o cxey a'. eriio fdx txyz tweci cs xn"c rnec a': c`iz qcex` ke' l`qzkl` ke', edo keepez dztld eigecim rliepim liecrim enyibim l`qzkl` ke', ki pty xeg pynd yldm rvno do "niio pewaio", anqixz ptym rl dzexd, eaptilz `tim, kpecr:
ldaio nd ykzea ayrx digecim txw a', crl ici zexd yl` akeepd pax`im nl`kim arelm divixd, eym dai` ndfdx txyz ylg: "cliz wl` c`z`aic ke' ax wl` c`exiiz` evlez` cqliw eawr ke'". edpd, nkeepz dztld pax`e nl`kim arelm daxi`d kne nkeepz dzexd, eal` keepd pcgiz lnhd lbnxi, kne ykzea afdx txyz tweci cs xn"d rnec a': "be xwir zz`d ke' c`wxio vlezio tqil`o ke'", eriio ym txyz eiwdl cs x"` rnec a': "`i di` nld kcw` i`ez ke'".

ed` cnynr lk`exd atxyz tweci, cbm ztld tqeld reld rc dikl dx`yeo ynnpe pcgiz lnhd, ede` a"frix `ptio" caxi`d l` wyd nici: ydxi `tile kl dreepez nny, wlez egnexez relez lym `tile rc dikl dc', kne ykzea cs xp"a rnec `', `l` ec`i, y`io ndez drliez yeez, e`io rxej ecnieo aipidm `l` ayizes dym alac, eci lnaio.
eafd ieao bm ko nd ykzea ym cs xn"f, yadikl da' `eli vxij ldiez: `fcno dnnepd. e`eli vxij ldiez: wiinio dlaeyim nnepd rl dlaeyim ynlaiyim dpynd nnryd dnvez, `s ydo abo rco dzgzeo cryid, kne ykzea ym cs x"i.
edpd, ztld tqeld rcit` nzexd yl` lynd nny, ydi` zgz dyny, edztld di` be xwir ke'. `al zexd qzm, y`ipd yl` lynd xw n`dad nqezxz hariz, l` bxr` ndal tido yl zipewz yl aiz xao, cqliw lril` ntpi yde` dal y`io ae gh`, eqliw lril`, `s `m de` yl` lynd nny, nix`z dxverd yaic dqetx, eriio ym cs xp"d rnec a', ydnl`kim dm nrlim ddal yl zipewz yl aiz xao rc `vilez:
ldaio nd ykzea atxi ru giim, cafno dfd, riwx daixex rl ici dztld cew`, `s yzlnec zexd lnrld ndztld.
